docs.title: 大​数据
docs.text: ​内存​中是​ numpy ​或​ cupy ​数组​，​磁盘​上​是​ zarr；​命令​用​自己​的​ worker ​分块​处理​，CPU ​或​多块​ GPU，​数据​可以​大于​内存​。​概念​

docs.title: 为​ agent ​而生
docs.text: ​每个​函数​都​是​一条​命令​，​帮助​完整​，​有​ --json ​输出​，pipeline ​从​中断​处续​跑​。​命令行​、Pipeline ​文件​

docs.title: Python、​命令行​或​对话
docs.text:
Python​命令行​对话​ 
import moraine as mr          # ​内存​中​的​数组​（CPU ​上​ numpy，GPU ​上​ cupy）
import moraine.cli as mc      # zarr ​进​、zarr ​出​，​分块​处理​

ph = mr.emi(coh)              # ​一块​点​的​相位​连接​
mc.emi('ds/coh.zarr', 'ds/ph.zarr', cuda=True)   # ​整个​数据​集​

moraine list                                    # ​所有​处理​命令​
moraine emi --help                              # ​参数​的​形状​、​类型​和​默认值​
moraine run examples/02_ps.toml --workdir WORK  # ​经过​验证​的​ pipeline；​再​运行​一次​即续​跑​
moraine info ps/ras_adi_pyramid                 # ​不​加载​数据​就​得到​结果​的​统计​量​
moraine quicklook ps/ras_adi_pyramid -o adi.png # ​整幅​场景​的​图​

​把​ /data/site_a ​的​ GAMMA ​数据​（​参考​影像​ 20220620）​处理​到​解缠​，​工作​目录​ /work/site_a

​任何​在​仓库​里​工作​的​编程​ agent（Claude Code、Codex、Cursor ​等​）​读​ AGENTS.md ​后​就​能​完成​其余​的​事​。​见​与​ AI ​对话​。

​安装​：pip install moraine（CPU），GPU ​另用​ conda ​装​ cupy ​和​ numba-cuda：​安装​。

docs.title: 与​ AI ​对话
docs.text:
moraine ​的​设计​目标​之一​是​让​ AI ​编程​ agent ​替​你​运行​它​：​仓库​里​带​着​说明​（AGENTS.md），​每条​命令​ ​都​能​自我​解释​（--help、--json），pipeline ​从​中断​处续​跑​，​结果​不用​写​绘图​脚本​就​能​检查​（moraine info、 moraine quicklook）。​你​用​自然语言​说明​数据​和​目标​；agent ​读​指南​、​运行​经过​验证​的​ pipeline、​把​结果​和​预期​范围​比​对​、 ​看​图​、​汇报​。

​一次​真实​会话​的​记录​

​下面​是​ 2026-10-08 ​一次​真实​会话​的​精简​记录​：Claude Code ​在​ moraine ​仓库​里​、​在​一个​ GPU ​节点​上​（​用​了​机器​上​的​一块​ A100，128 ​个​ CPU ​核​）​处理​ Campi Flegrei ​数据​集​（Sentinel-1 ​降轨​ track 22，2019-01-02 ​到​ 2021-12-29 ​共​ 92 ​景​， ​全​分辨率​ 981 x 4160 ​像​元​，GAMMA ​结果​在​ data/CampiFlegrei/gamma）。​会话​原文​是​英文​，​这里​是​译文​，agent ​的话​有​ ​删节​；​每条​命令​、​它​的​输出​、​数字​和​图​都​来自​那次​运行​。​五条​ pipeline ​的​计算​共​ 500 ​秒​。

​你​

​把​ data/CampiFlegrei/gamma ​里​的​ GAMMA ​数据​（​参考​影像​ 20200707）​处理​到​相位​解缠​，​工作​目录​ manual_demo/campi。 ​告诉​我​你​看到​了​什么​。

AI

​我读​了​ AGENTS.md、​第一个​工作​流​的​指南​（docs/workflows/01_load.md）​和​数据​集​说明​（data/CampiFlegrei/README.md）： 92 ​景​，​参考​影像​ 20200707，​地理​编码​文件​前缀​ 20200707，GAMMA ​在​ PATH ​上​（which base_calc）。​我用​一块​ GPU （CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=1）​和​ examples/ ​里​经过​验证​的​ pipeline，​按​顺序​运行​。

1. ​载入​ GAMMA ​结果​

$ moraine run examples/01_load.toml --workdir manual_demo/campi \
      --var gamma=data/CampiFlegrei/gamma --var reference=20200707 --var geo=20200707
[rslc] load-gamma-flatten-rslc ... done in 125.8 s
[lat_lon_hgt] load-gamma-lat-lon-hgt ... done in 6.9 s
[look_vector] load-gamma-look-vector ... done in 3.8 s
[range] load-gamma-range ... done in 0.1 s
[metadata] load-gamma-metadata ... done in 1.8 s
[web_mercator] transform ... done in 2.5 s
[rslc_pyramid] ras-pyramid ... done in 20.9 s
$ moraine info raw/rslc.zarr raw/rslc_pyramid
  raw/rslc.zarr: complex64 (981, 4160, 92) chunks (1000, 1000, 1)
  raw/rslc_pyramid: complex64 (981, 4160, 92) raster pyramid, 10 levels
    stats_level=3, nan_fraction=0.404627, amplitude_min=0.000157993, amplitude_max=25.4198,
    amplitude_mean=0.363668, amplitude_std=0.345799, amplitude_p01=0.0229478, amplitude_p50=0.288358, amplitude_p99=1.56296
$ moraine quicklook raw/rslc_pyramid --show intf_seq --index 0 -o 01_intf_seq_0.png

​堆栈​有​ 92 ​景​（raw/meta.toml ​列出​了​日期​，​间隔​ 12 ​天​），​幅度​在​预期​范围​内​（p50 0.29），40 % ​的​像​元​是​ nan：​那​是​ ​配​准时​被​掩​掉​的​ Pozzuoli ​海湾​，​和​数据​集​说明​一致​。​第一幅​ 12 ​天​干涉​图是​带​噪声​的​单视​相位​，​陆地​上​有​结构​，​没有​可疑​之​处​ （​如果​到处​都​是​均匀​噪声​，​说明​参考​影像​日期​错​了​）：

AI

2. PS ​候选​点​。 ​指南​要求​把​ shape ​设​为​堆栈​的​ (nlines, width)：981, 4160。

$ moraine run examples/02_ps.toml --workdir manual_demo/campi --var shape=981,4160
[adi] amp-disp ... done in 11.4 s
[n2f] n2f ... done in 32.3 s
[n2f_temp_coh] temp-coh ... done in 11.7 s
[ps_can] pc-union ... done in 0.3 s
[ps_can_data] ras2pc ... done in 6.0 s
(13 steps, 64 s)
$ moraine info ps/ras_adi_pyramid ps/ras_temp_coh_pyramid ps/ps_can_1_gix.zarr ps/ps_can_2_gix.zarr ps/ps_can_hix.zarr
  ps/ras_adi_pyramid: ... p01=0.255305, p50=0.541975, p99=0.786118
  ps/ras_temp_coh_pyramid: ... p01=0.124025, p50=0.428027, p99=0.973471, max=0.999438
  ps/ps_can_1_gix.zarr: int32 (148706, 2)
  ps/ps_can_2_gix.zarr: int32 (530416, 2)
  ps/ps_can_hix.zarr: int64 (530886,)

​对照​指南​：​幅度​离差​指数​ p50 0.54（​合理​范围​ 0.3 ​到​ 1），​时间​相干性​在​ 0 ​和​ 1 ​之间​，​没有​警告​。148 706 ​个​候选​点​的​ ​幅度​离差​指数​低于​ 0.4，530 416 ​个点​的​ Noise2Fringe ​时间​相干性​高于​ 0.58；​并集​ 530 886 ​个点​，​占​陆地​像​元​的​ 22 % （​指南​的​预期​是​百分之几​到​ 30 % ​左右​）。​相干性​在​建成区​高​、​在​火山口​湖低​；​候选​点​覆盖​ Pozzuoli、Bacoli ​和​那不勒斯​ ​西郊​，​火山口​和​山坡​上​没有​：

AI

3. DS。 Campi Flegrei ​教程​用​的​窗口​和​阈值​与​示例​相同​（7 x 27 ​窗口​、alpha 0.05、​至少​ 80 ​个​ SHP、​加权​时间​相干性​ 0.85），​所以​我​原样​运行​。

$ moraine run examples/03_ds.toml --workdir manual_demo/campi --var shape=981,4160
[shp_test] shp-test ... done in 9.0 s
[phase_linking] emperical-co-emi-temp-coh-pc ... done in 18.6 s
[ds_ph_pyramid] pc-pyramid ... done in 5.1 s
(16 steps, 42 s)
$ moraine info ds/ras_shp_num_pyramid ds/ds_can_t_coh_w_pyramid ds/ds_can_n_components_pyramid \
      ds/ds_can_hix.zarr ds/ds_connected_hix.zarr ds/ds_hix.zarr
  ds/ras_shp_num_pyramid: ... min=0.0, max=189.0, p50=29.0, p99=170.0
  ds/ds_can_t_coh_w_pyramid: ... p01=0.266186, p50=0.589956, p99=0.959546
  ds/ds_can_n_components_pyramid: ... min=1.0, max=85.0, p50=3.0
  ds/ds_can_hix.zarr: int64 (1123313,)
  ds/ds_connected_hix.zarr: int64 (326851,)
  ds/ds_hix.zarr: int64 (167007,)

1 123 313 ​个​像​元​至少​有​ 80 ​个​ SHP；​其中​ 326 851 ​个​（29.1 %）​的​ 92 ​景​影像​都​被​相干​像​对​连通​，​这些​点里​又​有​ 167 007 ​个​ ​的​加权​时间​相干性​达到​ 0.85：​这​就是​ DS，​占​候选​点​的​ 14.9 %，​与​指南​对​这个​数据​集​的​预期​一致​。​示例​的​ 7 x 27 ​窗口​在​地面​上​ ​约​ 100 m x 60 m：​在​ Sentinel-1 ​全​分辨率​下​，11 x 11 ​的​窗口​在​距离​向​只​覆盖​ 26 m，​对​ 92 ​景​来说​ SHP ​太​少​。​指南​说​ t_coh_w_min ​是​第一个​调节​项​（--var t_coh_w_min=0.9 ​可​保留​ 96 741 ​个点​）；​我​保留​默认值​并​如实​汇报​。​加权​时间​相干性​在​均匀​的​山坡​和​田地​上​高​， ​相位​连接​后​的​ DS ​在​ 2019 ​到​ 2021 ​年间​的​干涉​图​空间​上​是​一致​的​，​能​看到​ Pozzuoli ​周围​隆升​的​条纹​：

AI

4. ​合并​与​精化​

$ moraine run examples/04_refine.toml --workdir manual_demo/campi
[merge] pc-union ... done in 8.4 s
[n2ft] n2ft ... done in 28.1 s
[temp_coh] temp-coh ... done in 6.6 s
[pc_ph_pyramid] pc-pyramid ... done in 11.0 s
(9 steps, 95 s)
$ moraine info pc/pc_can_hix.zarr pc/pc_can_temp_coh_pyramid pc/pc_hix.zarr
  pc/pc_can_hix.zarr: int64 (590677,)
  pc/pc_can_temp_coh_pyramid: ... p01=0.21278, p50=0.792471, p99=0.995184
  pc/pc_hix.zarr: int64 (223875,)
$ moraine quicklook pc/pc_ph_pyramid --show intf_all --index 0 91 -o 04_pc_intf_0_91.png
$ moraine quicklook pc/pc_ph_pyramid --show intf_all --index 0 91 --extent 14.08,40.80,14.16,40.86 -o zoom.png

PS ​候选​点​和​ DS ​合并​成​ 675 687 ​个点​；​经过​ Noise2Fringe Transformer ​之后​，330 754 ​个点​（49 %）​的​时间​相干性​高于​ 0.8。 ​它们​首尾​两景​之间​的​干涉​图​显示​出以​ Pozzuoli ​为​中心​的​同心​隆升​条纹​，​三年​约​十个​条纹​，​穿过​城镇​连续​；​放大​到​ ​最细​层级​（​单个​点​）​后​，​密集​处​的​条纹​依然​清楚​：

AI

5. ​解缠​。 ​指南​要求​数据​的​像​元​间距​；​从​ gamma/rslc/20200707.rslc.par ​读​到​：​距离​向​ 2.329562 m，​方位​向​ 13.9516 m。

$ moraine run examples/05_unwrap.toml --workdir manual_demo/campi --var shape=981,4160 \
      --var range_pixel_spacing=2.329562 --var azimuth_pixel_spacing=13.9516
[gix] pc-gix ... done in 0.4 s
[pairs_seq] image-pairs ... done in 0.0 s
[unwrap] mcf-pc ... done in 1.0 s
[unw_pyramid] pc-pyramid ... done in 15.8 s
$ moraine info unw/pc_unw.zarr unw/pc_unw_pyramid
  unw/pc_unw.zarr: float32 (223875, 91) chunks (200000, 1)
  unw/pc_unw_pyramid: ... min=-17.2502, max=13.8788, p01=-6.97704, p50=-0.147673, p99=5.69298

330 754 ​个点​的​ 91 ​幅​序列​干涉​图​ 2 ​秒​解缠​完毕​；​数值​如​指南​所料​在​ 2π ​的​几倍​以内​，​把​结果​重新​缠绕​能​还原​输入​相位​ （​前​十幅​干涉​图​的​最大​差异​ 5.6e-7 rad）。​解缠​后​的​ 12 ​天​干涉​图​平滑​，​相邻​区域​之间​没有​孤立​的​ 2π ​跳变​：

$ moraine view unw/pc_unw_pyramid pc/pc_ph_pyramid --dates raw/meta.toml -o view.ipynb
saved view.ipynb: open it in Jupyter or VS Code and run all cells
AI

​完成​。 ​五条​ pipeline ​在​ Campi Flegrei ​堆栈​（92 ​景​，981 x 4160 ​像​元​）​上​跑​完​，​一块​ A100 ​上​共​ 500 ​秒​计算​；​每个​ ​结果​都​在​指南​的​范围​内​。

​步骤​ ​结果​ ​点数​ ​载入​ raw/rslc.zarr (981, 4160, 92) PS ​候选​点​ ps/ps_can_hix.zarr 530 886 DS ds/ds_hix.zarr、ds/ds_ph.zarr 1 123 313 ​个​候选​点中​的​ 167 007 ​精化​点​ pc/pc_hix.zarr、pc/pc_ph.zarr (330 754, 92) 330 754 ​解缠​ unw/pc_unw.zarr (330 754, 91)，​弧度​

​我​看到​的​：​火山口​以​ Pozzuoli ​为​中心​的​隆升​，​在​相位​连接​并​滤波​后​的​点​上​表现​为​ 2019-01-02 ​到​ 2021-12-29 ​之间​约​十个​ ​条纹​，​以及​平滑​的​ 12 ​天解​缠​干涉​图​。​有​两件事​要​你​决定​：DS ​筛选​只​保留​了​候选​点​的​ 14.9 %（t_coh_w_min 0.85），​降到​ 0.85 ​能​在​山坡​上​保留​更​多点​；​解缠​相位​还​没有​空间​参考​，​读​形变​之前​请​只​做​点​与​点​之间​的​相对​比较​，​或者​在​ view.ipynb ​里​双击​选​一个​参考点​。

docs.title: 原理
docs.text:
• AGENTS.md ​是​所有​ agent（Claude Code、Codex、Cursor ​等​）​的​入口​：​环境​、​怎样​运行​和续​跑​ pipeline、​怎样​检查​结果​、 ​数据​约定​和​规则​（​不往​样例​数据​里​写​、​一次​只​跑​一条​ GPU pipeline、​不删​结果​）。​各​工具​专用​的​文件​只​指向​它​（​决策​ 0008）， tests/test_docs.py ​保证​它​与​代码​一致​。
  • ​工作​流​指南​（docs/workflows/）​给​ agent ​的​正是​一位​同事​会​给​的​东西​：​参数​、​样例​数据​上​每个​结果​的​预期​范围​、​看​什么​、 ​数字​不​对​时​怎么办​。​示例​ pipeline ​每次​改动​前​都​在​真实​数据​上​验证​（​决策​ 0009、0033）。
  • ​能​自我​解释​的​命令​。 moraine list，moraine COMMAND --help ​给出​ docstring ​里​的​形状​、​类型​和​默认值​，​未知​参数​被​ ​拒绝​并​给出​建议​，--json ​在​ stdout ​打印​一个​对象​和​每个​输出​的​摘要​。
  • ​不用​画图​的​检查​。 moraine info ​从​金字塔​给出​统计​量​和​异常​警告​，moraine quicklook ​出​一张​ agent ​能​看​、​能​放大​的​ PNG，moraine view ​给​你​一个​ notebook。
  • ​可续​跑​的​ pipeline。 ​失败​的​步骤​打印​错误​和​日志​；agent ​修好​原因​后​再​运行​一次​文件​。​改了​参数​只重​跑​依赖​它​的​步骤​。

docs.title: 自己​试试
docs.text:
1. ​在​放​数据​的​机器​上​安装​ moraine（​数据​是​ GAMMA ​结果​的话​还要​装​ GAMMA），​最好​有​ GPU。
  2. ​克隆​仓库​，​或​把​ AGENTS.md、docs/workflows/ ​和​ examples/ ​复制到​数据​旁边​：​除了​ moraine ​命令​，agent ​只​需要​这些​。

  3. ​在​那个​目录​里​启动​你​的​ agent，​比如​这样​问​：

    ​把​ /data/site_a ​的​ GAMMA ​数据​（​参考​影像​ 20220620，​地理​编码​文件​前缀​ 20210802）​处理​到​解缠​，​工作​目录​ /work/site_a；​用​一块​ GPU，​告诉​我​你​看到​了​什么​

  4. ​读​它​的​汇报​，​看​ quicklook ​和​ view.ipynb，​再用​一句​话​提​要求​："​多留​一些​ DS"、"​改用​ EMCF ​解缠​冗余​网络​"、"​把​海掩​掉​"。

agent ​做​的​事​你​用​工作​流​和​命令行​都​能​自己​做​；​它​读​的​是​同样​的​页面​。

docs.title: Python API
docs.text:
import moraine as mr ​给出​数组​函数​：​作用​于​内存​中​ numpy ​数组​（CPU，numba）​或​ cupy ​数组​（GPU）​的​算法​，​按​主题​ ​分​在​ moraine.api ​的​各​模块​里​（​决策​ 0015），​并​以​ mr.<name> ​重新​导出​。​大多数​函数​两种​数组​都​接受​，​返回​同类​数组​。

import numpy as np
import moraine as mr
import moraine.api.utils_

ph = mr.emi(coh)                          # numpy ​进​，numpy ​出​
if moraine.api.utils_.is_cuda_available():
    import cupy as cp
    ph_gpu = mr.emi(cp.asarray(coh))      # cupy ​进​，cupy ​出​

​一次​调用​处理​一个​单元​：​整幅​场景​的​一景​影像​或​一个​像​对​，​或​一块​像​元​ / ​点​及其​完整​时间​序列​（​需要​邻域​时​再加​一圈​ halo）。​数据​大于​内存​时​，​命令行​用​ dask ​把​这些​函数​映射​到​ zarr ​的​各块​上​。

​模块​ ​主题​ ​主要​名字​ calamp SLC ​幅度​与​幅度​定标​ rslc2amp、calamp pc ​点云​索引​（​网格​ / hilbert）、​排序​、​集合​运算​、​栅格​与​点云​互转​ pc_hix、pc_sort、pc_union、ras2pc、pc2ras rtree ​点云​的​ hilbert R ​树​，​包围​盒​查询​ HilbertRtree tnet ​时间​网络​：​像​对​ TempNet polygon ​多边形​ GeoJSON ​文件​，​点​在​多边形​内​ read_polygons、polygons_contain ps PS ​筛选​用​的​幅度​离差​指数​ amp_disp shp ​统计​同质​像​元​（KS ​检验​） ks_test、select_shp co ​干涉​图​、​相干​矩阵​、​正则​化​ emperical_co_pc、uncompress_coh、nearestPD pl ​相位​连接​（EMI）​与​ DS ​时间​相干性​ emi、ds_temp_coh、emperical_co_emi_temp_coh_pc dl ​深度​学习​滤波​与​模型​下载​ n2f、n2fs3d、n2ft、download_dl_model pqm ​像​元​质量​：​时间​相干性​ temp_coh unwrap Delaunay ​三角网​、​最小​费用​流​、EMCF、​相位​闭合​校正​、GAMMA mcf_pt delaunay、mcf_pc、emcf_pc、unwrap_correct_closure_pc utils numba ​装饰​器​、GPU ​检测​、numpy / cupy ​分派​（moraine.api.utils_，​未​重新​导出​） is_cuda_available、get_array_module

​每页​列出​每个​公开​函数​的​签名​和​ docstring（​形状​、​类型​、​单位​、​默认值​；​英文​），​以及​在​合成​数据​上​的​小​示例​。​示例​在​构建​ ​本手册​时​真实​运行​，​所以​它们​和​文档​对应​的​版本​一定​是​匹配​的​。​所有​函数​共用​的​数据​约定​见​数据​约定​（​英文​）。

import numpy as np
import moraine as mr

rng = np.random.default_rng(0)
rslc = (rng.standard_normal((4, 5, 3)) + 1j * rng.standard_normal((4, 5, 3))).astype(np.complex64)   # (nlines, width, nimages)

docs.title: zarr ​与​ dask ​辅助​函数
docs.text: moraine.cli.dask_ ​里​是​命令​使用​的​并行​ zarr ​读写​：dask_from_zarr(path, chunks) ​和​ dask_from_zarr_overlap(...) ​把​ zarr ​数组​变成​ dask ​数组​（​后者​带​ halo），dask_to_zarr(darr, path, chunks) ​写回​，parallel_read_zarr / parallel_write_zarr ​用​线程​读写​整个​数组​，ZarrDir ​遍历​按块​存放​的​ zarr ​目录​（docs/contracts/data.md）。​并行​读写​ ​的​错误​会​被​抛出​。

docs.title: co: Covariance and coherence matrix estimation
docs.text: moraine.api.co（​源码​）。​每个​名字​也​是​ moraine.<name>（import moraine as mr）。

docs.title: 示例
docs.text:
​构建​本手册​时​运行​；​输出​紧随​每​段​代码​。

import numpy as np
import moraine as mr

rng = np.random.default_rng(0)
nlines, width, nimages = 20, 30, 10
rslc = (rng.standard_normal((nlines, width, nimages)) + 1j * rng.standard_normal((nlines, width, nimages))).astype(np.complex64)
idx = np.array([[5, 5], [10, 15]], dtype=np.int32)              # (azimuth, range) of two points
pc_is_shp = np.ones((2, 5, 5), dtype=bool)                      # their SHPs in a 5 x 5 window (all here)

coh = mr.emperical_co_pc(rslc, idx, pc_is_shp)                   # compressed coherence, (n_points, n_pairs)
print(coh.shape, coh.dtype)
C = mr.uncompress_coh(coh)                                       # full hermitian matrices, (n_points, nimages, nimages)
print(C.shape, np.allclose(np.diagonal(C, axis1=1, axis2=2).real, 1, atol=1e-5))
print(mr.isPD(np.abs(C)))                                        # is the coherence magnitude matrix positive definite?

(2, 45) complex64
(2, 10, 10) True
[ True  True]

bad = np.abs(C[0]).copy()
bad[0, 1] = bad[1, 0] = 1.5                                      # not a valid coherence matrix any more
print(mr.isPD(bad[None])[0], mr.isPD(mr.nearestPD(bad[None]))[0])
intf = mr.intf(np.ascontiguousarray(rslc[..., 0]), np.ascontiguousarray(rslc[..., 1]))   # 1 x 1 look interferogram of two images
print(intf.shape, intf.dtype)

False True
(20, 30) complex64

The compressed layout is the upper triangle in the order of numpy.triu_indices(nimages, 1) (data contract); emperical_co_pc(..., return_n_looks=True) also gives the effective number of independent looks of each SHP set, the input of the weighted DS temporal coherence.

docs.title: dl: Deep learning operators: Noise2Fringe (n2f, n2fs3d) and Noise2Fringe Transformer (n2ft) filtering
docs.text: moraine.api.dl（​源码​）。​每个​名字​也​是​ moraine.<name>（import moraine as mr）。

docs.title: 示例
docs.text:
​构建​本手册​时​运行​；​输出​紧随​每​段​代码​。

The filters need PyTorch and the trained models (moraine.download_dl_model()), so this example is not run when the manual is built.

import numpy as np
import moraine as mr

mr.download_dl_model()                                   # once; the .pth files go to moraine/dl_model/

# rasters: Noise2Fringe on an interferogram stack (nlines, width, n_pairs), chunked with halos (depths)
intf_filtered = mr.n2f(intf, chunks=(256, 256), depths=(32, 32))

# with the amplitude dispersion index as a second input
intf_filtered = mr.n2fs3d(adi, intf, chunks=(256, 256), depths=(32, 32))

# point clouds: the Noise2Fringe Transformer on (n_points, n_pairs) with the coordinates of the points
intf_filtered = mr.n2ft(lon, lat, intf, chunks=20000, k=128, cuda=True)

The outputs have unit amplitude; the temporal coherence between the filtered and the raw interferograms (temp_coh) is the quality of a pixel or point.

import numpy as np
import moraine as mr

shape = (8, 8)                                                   # (nlines, width) of the raster

print(hix1)
order = mr.pc_sort(hix1)                                         # point clouds are kept in hilbert order

gix2 = np.array([[2, 3], [7, 0]], dtype=np.int32)

print(hix, mr.pc_gix(hix, shape).tolist())
print(in1, in2, new2)                                            # where the points of each input went

docs.title: pl: Phase linking
docs.text: moraine.api.pl（​源码​）。​每个​名字​也​是​ moraine.<name>（import moraine as mr）。

docs.title: 示例
docs.text:
​构建​本手册​时​运行​；​输出​紧随​每​段​代码​。

import numpy as np
import moraine as mr

rng = np.random.default_rng(0)
nimages, n_points = 8, 3
phi = rng.uniform(-np.pi, np.pi, (n_points, nimages))            # a true phase history per point
phi[:, 0] = 0
ph_true = np.exp(1j * phi)
lag = np.abs(np.arange(nimages)[:, None] - np.arange(nimages)[None, :])
gamma = 0.7 ** lag                                               # coherence magnitude decaying with the time lag
C = gamma * ph_true[:, :, None] * np.conj(ph_true[:, None, :])   # (n_points, nimages, nimages)
i, j = np.triu_indices(nimages, 1)
coh = C[:, i, j].astype(np.complex64)                            # compressed, (n_points, n_pairs)

ph = mr.emi(coh)                                                 # phase linking, (n_points, nimages), unit amplitude
print(ph.shape, ph.dtype)
print('max phase error [rad]', np.abs(np.angle(ph * np.conj(ph_true))).max().round(4))
t_coh = mr.ds_temp_coh(coh, ph)                                  # how well the linked phases explain the coherence
print('temporal coherence', t_coh.round(3))

(3, 8) complex64
max phase error [rad] 0.0
temporal coherence [1. 1. 1.]

Coherence estimated from few looks is often not positive definite; emi regularizes such matrices by default (regularize=True). With n_looks (from emperical_co_pc) ds_temp_coh also returns the weighted temporal coherence, the effective number of image pairs and the number of connected components of the coherent pairs, the quantities the DS selection uses.

import os

docs.title: pqm: Pixel quality metrics
docs.text: moraine.api.pqm（​源码​）。​每个​名字​也​是​ moraine.<name>（import moraine as mr）。

docs.title: 示例
docs.text:
​构建​本手册​时​运行​；​输出​紧随​每​段​代码​。

import numpy as np
import moraine as mr

rng = np.random.default_rng(0)
n_points, nimages = 4, 6
phi = rng.uniform(-np.pi, np.pi, (n_points, nimages))
ph = np.exp(1j * phi).astype(np.complex64)                       # phase history of the points, (n_points, nimages)
pairs = mr.TempNet.from_bandwidth(nimages, bandwidth=1).image_pairs
clean = (ph[:, pairs[:, 0]] * np.conj(ph[:, pairs[:, 1]])).astype(np.complex64)   # the sequential interferograms
noise = np.exp(1j * 0.6 * rng.standard_normal((n_points, nimages))).astype(np.complex64)
noise[0] = 1                                                     # the first point is clean

t_coh = mr.temp_coh(clean, ph * noise, pairs)                   # agreement of the (filtered) interferograms with the raw phases
print(t_coh.shape, t_coh.dtype)
print(t_coh.round(3))

(4,) float32
[1.    0.968 0.566 0.856]

In the pipelines the interferograms are the deep learning filtered ones and rslc the raw stack or phase history: points whose filtered phase agrees with the raw phase are kept.

docs.title: ps: persistent scatterers identification
docs.text: moraine.api.ps（​源码​）。​每个​名字​也​是​ moraine.<name>（import moraine as mr）。

docs.title: 示例
docs.text:
​构建​本手册​时​运行​；​输出​紧随​每​段​代码​。

import numpy as np
import moraine as mr

rng = np.random.default_rng(0)
nimages = 20
# a stable scatterer (constant amplitude, small noise) next to noisy pixels
stable = 5 + 0.2 * rng.standard_normal((3, 3, nimages))
noisy = np.abs(rng.standard_normal((3, 3, nimages))) + 0.1
amp = np.concatenate([stable, noisy], axis=1)
rslc = (amp * np.exp(1j * rng.uniform(-np.pi, np.pi, amp.shape))).astype(np.complex64)   # (nlines, width, nimages)

adi = mr.amp_disp(rslc)                       # amplitude dispersion index (std / mean over time), (nlines, width)
print(adi.shape, adi.dtype)
print('stable pixels', adi[:, :3].mean().round(3), ' noisy pixels', adi[:, 3:].mean().round(3))

(3, 6) float32
stable pixels 0.037  noisy pixels 0.692

PS candidates are the pixels with a low index, e.g. adi < 0.4 (pc-logic-ras in the pipelines).

docs.title: rtree: Rectangle tree for fast point cloud data query
docs.text: moraine.api.rtree（​源码​）。​每个​名字​也​是​ moraine.<name>（import moraine as mr）。

docs.title: 示例
docs.text:
​构建​本手册​时​运行​；​输出​紧随​每​段​代码​。

import numpy as np
import moraine as mr

rng = np.random.default_rng(0)
x, y = rng.random(3000), rng.random(3000)                        # e.g. longitude, latitude of points
tree = mr.HilbertRtree.build(x, y, page_size=64)                 # page_size: points per leaf (the chunk size of the point cloud)
idx = tree.bbox_query([0.2, 0.2, 0.4, 0.4], x, y)                # indices of the points in the box [x0, y0, xm, ym]
print(len(idx), idx[:5])
print(np.all((x[idx] >= 0.2) & (x[idx] <= 0.4) & (y[idx] >= 0.2) & (y[idx] <= 0.4)))

112 [18 41 44 64 68]
True

tree.save(path) / HilbertRtree.load(path) keep the tree as a zarr array next to a point cloud; the viewer uses it to read only the points on screen.

docs.title: shp: Spatially Homogeneous Pixels Identification
docs.text: moraine.api.shp（​源码​）。​每个​名字​也​是​ moraine.<name>（import moraine as mr）。

docs.title: 示例
docs.text:
​构建​本手册​时​运行​；​输出​紧随​每​段​代码​。

import numpy as np
import moraine as mr

rng = np.random.default_rng(0)
nlines, width, nimages = 12, 16, 30
# two homogeneous regions of different brightness, side by side (exponential intensity: speckle)
rmli = rng.exponential(1.0, (nlines, width, nimages)).astype(np.float32)
rmli[:, 8:] *= 4.0
p = mr.ks_test(rmli, az_half_win=2, r_half_win=2)                 # p value of the KS test, (nlines, width, 5, 5)
is_shp, shp_num = mr.select_shp(p, alpha=0.05)                   # SHP: p >= alpha
print(p.shape, is_shp.shape, shp_num.shape, shp_num.dtype)
print('inside the left region', shp_num[6, 3], ' at the boundary', shp_num[6, 7], ' of', 5 * 5)

(12, 16, 5, 5) (12, 16, 5, 5) (12, 16) int32
inside the left region 23  at the boundary 15  of 25

A pixel with many SHPs is a DS candidate (e.g. shp_num >= 50 of a 11 x 11 window in the pipelines); is_shp is the input of the coherence estimation.

docs.title: unwrap: phase unwrapping
docs.text: moraine.api.unwrap（​源码​）。​每个​名字​也​是​ moraine.<name>（import moraine as mr），​除了​ delaunay_halfedges, delaunay（​从​模块​导入​）。

docs.title: 示例
docs.text:
​构建​本手册​时​运行​；​输出​紧随​每​段​代码​。

import numpy as np
import moraine as mr
from moraine.api.unwrap.delaunay_ import delaunay

rng = np.random.default_rng(0)
n = 400
x, y = rng.uniform(0, 1000, n), rng.uniform(0, 1000, n)         # point coordinates in meters, unique
simplices, neighbors = delaunay(x, y)                            # Delaunay triangulation (scipy.spatial.Delaunay format)
print(simplices.shape, neighbors.shape)

phi = 0.004 * x + 0.006 * y                                      # a phase ramp of a few cycles (less than pi between neighbours)
ph = np.exp(1j * phi).astype(np.complex64)                       # the wrapped interferogram
unw = mr.mcf_pc(x, y, ph)                                        # minimum cost flow unwrapping, (n,)
err = (unw - unw[0]) - (phi - phi[0])
print('max error [rad]', np.abs(err).max().round(6))

(781, 3) (781, 3)
max error [rad] 0.0

nimages = 4
phis = np.stack([k * phi / 3 for k in range(nimages)], axis=1)   # a phase history growing with time
phs = np.exp(1j * phis).astype(np.complex64)                     # (n_points, nimages)
unw, pairs = mr.emcf_pc(x, y, phs, image_pairs=mr.TempNet.from_bandwidth(nimages, bandwidth=2).image_pairs)
print(unw.shape, pairs.shape)
truth = phis[:, pairs[:, 0]] - phis[:, pairs[:, 1]]
err = (unw - unw[:1]) - (truth - truth[:1])
print('max error [rad]', np.abs(err).max().round(6))

(400, 5) (5, 2)
max error [rad] 0.0

unwrap_correct_closure_pc corrects the interferograms of a network where loops do not close and gives the unwrapped phase of every image; gamma_mcf_pt wraps GAMMA's mcf_pt for comparison.

docs.title: 命令行
docs.text:
moraine.cli ​的​每个​处理函数​都​是​ moraine ​可执行程序​的​一条​子​命令​。​选项​、​类型​和​帮助​文本​由​函数​签名​和​ numpy docstring ​生成​（​决策​ 0005），​所以​本节​的​页面​就是​ moraine COMMAND --help ​的​内容​，moraine.cli ​的​每个​模块​一页​ （docstring ​是​英文​的​）：

moraine list                        # ​所有​处理​命令​，​按​模块​
moraine amp-disp --help             # ​某条​命令​的​参数​
moraine amp-disp --rslc raw/rslc.zarr --adi ps/ras_adi.zarr --cuda

docs.title: 约定
docs.text:
• ​参数​写成​ --name VALUE；--a-b ​等同于​ --a_b。​布尔值​是​ --cuda / --no-cuda。​路径​列表​接受​多个​值​ （--ras a.zarr b.zarr）。​元组​给出​它​的​整数​（--chunks 1000 1000，​也​可以​ 1000,1000）。​像​对​是​ image-pairs ​生成​的​文件​（​两列​整数​）​或​字面​量​ [[0,1],[1,2]]。
  • ​未知​的​参数​名是​错误​，​并​给出​建议​；​什么​都​不会​悄悄​传进​ **kwargs。​额外​的​关键字​参数​（​例如​ dask ​集群​选项​）​要​ ​显式​给出​：--kw memory_limit=20GB。
  • ​每个​参数​的​帮助​都​写明​ input ​或​ output、​数组​的​形状​和​类型​、​单位​和​默认值​。​路径​相对​于​当前目录​；​输出​会​被​覆盖​。
  • ​每条​命令​的​全局​选项​：--json（stdout ​上​一个​ JSON ​对象​，​日志​走​ stderr，​见​约定​）、 --traceback、--log FILE、-q / --quiet。
  • --cuda ​在​ CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES ​列出​的​ GPU ​上​运行​，​每块​一个​ dask worker；--n_workers、--threads_per_worker ​和​ --processes ​决定​ CPU ​集群​的​大小​。

docs.title: co: Covariance and coherence matrix estimation (CLI)
docs.text:
moraine.cli.co ​的​命令​（​源码​）；​同样​的​函数​在​ Python ​里​以​ mc.<name>(...) ​调用​（import moraine.cli as mc）。​下面​的​帮助​由​ docstring ​生成​，​与​ moraine COMMAND --help ​相同​（docstring ​为​英文​）。

​命令​ ​摘要​ emperical-co-pc estimate emperical coherence matrix on point cloud data.

docs.title: emperical-co-pc
docs.text:
estimate emperical coherence matrix on point cloud data.

moraine emperical-co-pc --rslc STR --is_shp_dir STR --gix STR --coh_dir STR [--n_looks_dir STR] [--image_pairs FILE] [--chunks INT INT] [--cuda | --no-cuda] [--processes VALUE] [--n_workers VALUE] [--threads_per_worker VALUE]
​参数​ ​类型​ ​默认值​ ​说明​ --rslc str ​必需​ input rslc stack, shape (nlines, width, nimages) --is_shp_dir str ​必需​ input directory with the SHP bool arrays of the points, one zarr per raster chunk, made by ras2pc_ras_chunk --gix str ​必需​ input grid index of the point cloud (azimuth, range), shape (n_points, 2), int --coh_dir str ​必需​ output directory with the complex coherence of the image pairs of the points, shape (n_points, n_image_pairs), one zarr per raster chunk; merge with pc_concat and the key of ras2pc_ras_chunk --n_looks_dir str None output directory with the effective number of independent looks of the SHP set of each point, float32, shape (n_points,), one zarr per raster chunk (merge as coh_dir): the number of independent looks with the same variance of the coherence estimate as the correlated SHPs, from their positions and the speckle correlation of rslc; input n_looks of ds-temp-coh --image_pairs np.ndarray None input image pairs (element in the coherence matrix) to be calculated, all image pairs by default --chunks tuple[int, int] None parallel processing (azimuth, range) chunk size. Default: rslc.chunks[:2] --cuda bool False if use cuda for processing, false by default --processes None use processes (True) or threads (False) for the workers, only for cpu processing. Default: False --n_workers None number of workers. Default: 1 for cpu, one per GPU for cuda --threads_per_worker None tasks a worker runs at the same time. Default: 2

​全局​选项​：--json、--traceback、--log FILE、-q / --quiet（​约定​）。

​在​ pipeline ​文件​中​（​示例​ pipeline ​未​使用​此​命令​；​只列​必需​参数​）：

[[step]]
name = "emperical_co_pc"
run = "emperical-co-pc"
rslc = "..."
is_shp_dir = "..."
gix = "..."
coh_dir = "..."

​在​ Python ​中​：

import moraine.cli as mc
mc.emperical_co_pc(rslc, is_shp_dir, gix, coh_dir, n_looks_dir=None, image_pairs=None, chunks=None, cuda=False, processes=None, n_workers=None, threads_per_worker=None)

​数组​函数​ mr.emperical_co_pc ​对​内存​中​的​ numpy / cupy ​数组​做​同样​的​事​。

docs.title: dl: Deep learning operators (CLI)
docs.text:
moraine.cli.dl ​的​命令​（​源码​）；​同样​的​函数​在​ Python ​里​以​ mc.<name>(...) ​调用​（import moraine.cli as mc）。​下面​的​帮助​由​ docstring ​生成​，​与​ moraine COMMAND --help ​相同​（docstring ​为​英文​）。

​命令​ ​摘要​ n2f Noise2Fringe (n2f) filtering of raster interferograms n2ft Noise2Fringe Transformer (n2ft) filtering of point cloud interferograms

docs.title: n2f
docs.text:
Noise2Fringe (n2f) filtering of raster interferograms. With cuda the network runs in half precision. A task filters one output chunk with all image pairs: it holds the rslc of one processing chunk with its overlap for all images (8 bytes per pixel and image), the filtered interferograms of the output chunk (8 bytes per pixel and image pair) and the model's activations of one interferogram (about 1 kB per pixel of the processing chunk on the GPU, 2 kB on the CPU); with cuda all of it on the GPU. A worker runs threads_per_worker tasks at a time.

moraine n2f --rslc STR --intf STR --image_pairs FILE [--chunks INT INT] [--out_chunks INT INT] [--depths INT INT] [--model STR] [--cuda | --no-cuda] [--processes VALUE] [--n_workers VALUE] [--threads_per_worker VALUE]
​参数​ ​类型​ ​默认值​ ​说明​ --rslc str ​必需​ input rslc stack, shape (nlines, width, nimages) --intf str ​必需​ output filtered interferograms, complex64 with unit amplitude (nan where the input is nan), shape (nlines, width, n_image_pairs) --image_pairs np.ndarray ​必需​ input image pairs (reference, secondary), shape (n_image_pairs, 2); make a file with moraine image-pairs --chunks tuple[int, int] None (azimuth, range) processing chunk size, same as rslc by default; the processing chunks are cut at the output chunks --out_chunks tuple[int, int] None (azimuth, range) chunk size of the output, same as rslc by default; it sets the memory of a worker --depths tuple[int, int], 0) (0, 0) (azimuth, range) overlap in pixels between processing chunks, reduces chunk border effects --model str None path to the model weights (.pth), use the model comes with this package by default --cuda bool False if use cuda for processing, false by default --processes None use processes (True) or threads (False) for the workers, only for cpu processing. Default: True --n_workers None number of workers. Default: 1 for cpu, one per GPU for cuda --threads_per_worker None output chunks a worker filters at the same time. Default: 1

​全局​选项​：--json、--traceback、--log FILE、-q / --quiet（​约定​）。

​在​ pipeline ​文件​中​（examples/02_ps.toml，​步骤​ n2f）：

[[step]]
name = "n2f"                      # Noise2Fringe filtering of the sequential interferograms
run = "n2f"
rslc = "raw/rslc.zarr"
intf = "ps/ras_n2f_intf.zarr"
image_pairs = "ps/pairs_seq.txt"

​在​ Python ​中​：

import moraine.cli as mc
mc.n2f(rslc, intf, image_pairs, chunks=None, out_chunks=None, depths=(0, 0), model=None, cuda=False, processes=None, n_workers=None, threads_per_worker=None)

​数组​函数​ mr.n2f ​对​内存​中​的​ numpy / cupy ​数组​做​同样​的​事​。

docs.title: n2ft
docs.text:
Noise2Fringe Transformer (n2ft) filtering of point cloud interferograms. Every worker filters one output chunk of points with all image pairs at a time: it holds the rslc of the points of the chunk and of their halos for the images of the pairs (8 bytes per point and image), the filtered interferograms of the chunk (8 bytes per point and image pair) and about 400 bytes per point of the chunk more; with cuda a model call holds about a fifth of the GPU memory. Before, the main process finds the halos of all processing chunks with about 70 bytes per point and 32 threads of 16 x k x chunks bytes (41 MB each by default).

moraine n2ft --x STR --y STR --rslc STR --intf STR --image_pairs FILE [--chunks VALUE] [--out_chunks VALUE] [--k VALUE] [--model STR] [--cuda | --no-cuda] [--compile | --no-compile] [--processes VALUE] [--n_workers VALUE] [--threads_per_worker VALUE]
​参数​ ​类型​ ​默认值​ ​说明​ --x str ​必需​ input x coordinate of the points (e.g. longitude or easting), shape (n_points,) --y str ​必需​ input y coordinate of the points (e.g. latitude or northing), shape (n_points,) --rslc str ​必需​ input rslc of the points, shape (n_points, nimages) --intf str ​必需​ output filtered interferograms, complex64 with unit amplitude, shape (n_points, n_image_pairs) --image_pairs np.ndarray ​必需​ input image pairs (reference, secondary), shape (n_image_pairs, 2); make a file with moraine image-pairs --chunks int None number of points per processing chunk, same as rslc by default; the processing chunks do not cross the output chunks --out_chunks int None point chunk size of the output, same as rslc by default; it sets the memory of a worker --k int 128 number of nearest neighbours of every point of a processing chunk that are filtered with it (halo) --model str None path to the model weights (.pth), use the model comes with this package by default --cuda bool False if use cuda for processing, false by default --compile bool None compile the model with torch.compile in every worker: the model then runs about 3 times faster on a GPU, but the compilation takes 15-40 s per worker (less when torch has cached it on disk). Default: when points times image pairs is at least 1e8 --processes None use processes (True) or threads (False) for the workers, only for cpu processing. Default: True --n_workers None number of workers. Default: 1 for cpu, one per GPU for cuda --threads_per_worker None tasks a worker runs at the same time. Default: 1

​全局​选项​：--json、--traceback、--log FILE、-q / --quiet（​约定​）。

​在​ pipeline ​文件​中​（examples/04_refine.toml，​步骤​ n2ft）：

[[step]]
name = "n2ft"                     # Noise2Fringe Transformer filtering of the sequential interferograms
run = "n2ft"
x = "pc/pc_can_lon.zarr"
y = "pc/pc_can_lat.zarr"
rslc = "pc/pc_can_ph.zarr"
intf = "pc/pc_can_n2ft_intf.zarr"
image_pairs = "pc/pairs_seq.txt"
chunks = 20000

​在​ Python ​中​：

import moraine.cli as mc
mc.n2ft(x, y, rslc, intf, image_pairs, chunks=None, out_chunks=None, k=128, model=None, cuda=False, compile=None, processes=None, n_workers=None, threads_per_worker=None)

​数组​函数​ mr.n2ft ​对​内存​中​的​ numpy / cupy ​数组​做​同样​的​事​。

​命令​ ​摘要​ load-gamma-flatten-rslc Generate flatten rslc data from gamma command and convert them into zarr format load-gamma-lat-lon-hgt Function to load longitude and latitude from gamma binary format to zarr load-gamma-look-vector Load look vector (elevation angle and orientation angle) in map geometry from gamma binary format to look vector in radar geometry zarr file load-gamma-range Generate slant range distance and save to zarr. load-gamma-metadata Load necessary metadata into a toml file.

docs.title: load-gamma-flatten-rslc
docs.text:
Generate flatten rslc data from gamma command and convert them into zarr format. The shape of hgt should be same as one rslc image, i.e. the hgt file is generated with 1 by 1 look geocoding. All data equal to 0 are replaced with nan.

moraine load-gamma-flatten-rslc --rslc_dir STR --reference STR --hgt STR --scratch_dir STR --rslc STR [--chunks INT INT] [--gamma_threads VALUE] [--processes | --no-processes] [--n_workers VALUE] [--threads_per_worker VALUE]
​参数​ ​类型​ ​默认值​ ​说明​ --rslc_dir str ​必需​ input GAMMA rslc directory with '????????.rslc' and '????????.rslc.par' files --reference str ​必需​ reference date, eg: '20200202' --hgt str ​必需​ input DEM height in radar coordinates (GAMMA float), same size as one rslc --scratch_dir str ​必需​ directory for preserve gamma intermediate files --rslc str ​必需​ output flattened rslc stack, shape (nlines, width, nimages), complex64 --chunks tuple[int, int], 1000) (1000, 1000) rslc chunk size --gamma_threads int, number of CPU cores) 4 number of threads of each GAMMA program run for an image (phase_sim_orb, set with OMP_NUM_THREADS) --processes False use processes for the workers instead of threads --n_workers 1 number of workers --threads_per_worker 1 tasks a worker runs at the same time

​全局​选项​：--json、--traceback、--log FILE、-q / --quiet（​约定​）。

​在​ pipeline ​文件​中​（examples/01_load.toml，​步骤​ rslc）：

[[step]]
name = "rslc"
run = "load-gamma-flatten-rslc"
rslc_dir = "${gamma}/rslc"
reference = "${reference}"
hgt = "${gamma}/geocoding/${geo}.hgt"
scratch_dir = "raw/scratch"
rslc = "raw/rslc.zarr"

​在​ Python ​中​：

import moraine.cli as mc
mc.load_gamma_flatten_rslc(rslc_dir, reference, hgt, scratch_dir, rslc, chunks=(1000, 1000), gamma_threads=4, processes=False, n_workers=1, threads_per_worker=1)

docs.title: load-gamma-lat-lon-hgt
docs.text:
Function to load longitude and latitude from gamma binary format to zarr. All data equal to 0 are replaced with nan.

moraine load-gamma-lat-lon-hgt --diff_par STR --rslc_par STR --dem_par STR --hgt STR --scratch_dir STR --lat_zarr STR --lon_zarr STR --hgt_zarr STR [--chunks INT INT]
​参数​ ​类型​ ​默认值​ ​说明​ --diff_par str ​必需​ input geocoding diff_par, using the simulated image as reference --rslc_par str ​必需​ input par file of the reference rslc --dem_par str ​必需​ input DEM par file --hgt str ​必需​ input DEM height in radar coordinates (GAMMA float) --scratch_dir str ​必需​ directory for preserve gamma intermediate files --lat_zarr str ​必需​ output, latitude zarr --lon_zarr str ​必需​ output, longitude zarr --hgt_zarr str ​必需​ output, height zarr --chunks tuple[int, int], 1000) (1000, 1000) rslc chunk size

​全局​选项​：--json、--traceback、--log FILE、-q / --quiet（​约定​）。

​在​ pipeline ​文件​中​（examples/01_load.toml，​步骤​ lat_lon_hgt）：

[[step]]
name = "lat_lon_hgt"

rslc_par = "${gamma}/rslc/${reference}.rslc.par"

​在​ Python ​中​：

docs.title: load-gamma-look-vector
docs.text:
Load look vector (elevation angle and orientation angle) in map geometry from gamma binary format to look vector in radar geometry zarr file. The two input data should be generated with the look_vector gamma command. All data equal to 0 are replaced with nan.

​命令​ ​摘要​ math Basic math manipulation

docs.title: math
docs.text:
Basic math manipulation. Only elementwise operations are supported. Only one output is supported.

moraine math --output STR --operation STR [--kw KEY=VALUE]
​参数​ ​类型​ ​默认值​ ​说明​ --output str ​必需​ output path of the result, same shape and chunks as the inputs --operation str ​必需​ numexpr expression of the input arrays, e.g. 'sin(a)*exp(b)/2' --kw KEY=VALUE ​额外​关键字​参数​，​可​重复​：input: the arrays used in operation as NAME=zarr path, e.g. a='a.zarr' (on the command line: --kw a=a.zarr)

​全局​选项​：--json、--traceback、--log FILE、-q / --quiet（​约定​）。

​在​ pipeline ​文件​中​（​示例​ pipeline ​未​使用​此​命令​；​只列​必需​参数​）：

[[step]]
name = "math"
run = "math"
output = "..."
operation = "..."

​在​ Python ​中​：

import moraine.cli as mc
mc.math(output, operation, **data)

docs.title: pc: Point cloud data utilities (CLI)
docs.text:
moraine.cli.pc ​的​命令​（​源码​）；​同样​的​函数​在​ Python ​里​以​ mc.<name>(...) ​调用​（import moraine.cli as mc）。​下面​的​帮助​由​ docstring ​生成​，​与​ moraine COMMAND --help ​相同​（docstring ​为​英文​）。

​命令​ ​摘要​ gix2bool Convert pc grid index to bool 2d array bool2gix Convert bool 2d array to grid index ras2pc Convert raster data to point cloud data pc-concat concatenate (and sort) point cloud dataset. ras2pc-ras-chunk Convert raster data to point cloud data that sorted by ras chunk pc2ras Convert point cloud data to raster data, filled with nan pc-hix Compute the hillbert index from grid index for point cloud data. pc-gix Compute the grid index from hillbert index for point cloud data. pc-sort Sort point cloud data according to the indices that sort idx_in. pc-union Get the union of two point cloud datasets pc-intersect Get the intersection of two point cloud datasets. pc-diff Get the points of the first point cloud dataset that are not in the second one. pc-logic-ras generate point cloud index based on logical operation of one raster image. pc-logic-pc generate point cloud index and data based on logical operation one point cloud data. pc-select-data generate point cloud data based on its index and one point cloud data

docs.title: gix2bool
docs.text:
Convert pc grid index to bool 2d array

moraine gix2bool --gix STR --is_pc STR --shape INT INT [--chunks INT INT]
​参数​ ​类型​ ​默认值​ ​说明​ --gix str ​必需​ input grid index (azimuth, range) of the point cloud, shape (n_points, 2), int --is_pc str ​必需​ output bool raster, True at the points, shape (nlines, width) --shape tuple[int, int] ​必需​ raster shape (nlines, width) --chunks tuple[int, int], 1000) (1000, 1000) output chunk size

​全局​选项​：--json、--traceback、--log FILE、-q / --quiet（​约定​）。

​在​ pipeline ​文件​中​（​示例​ pipeline ​未​使用​此​命令​；​只列​必需​参数​）：

[[step]]
name = "gix2bool"
run = "gix2bool"
gix = "..."
is_pc = "..."
shape = "..."

​在​ Python ​中​：

import moraine.cli as mc
mc.gix2bool(gix, is_pc, shape, chunks=(1000, 1000))

docs.title: bool2gix
docs.text:
Convert bool 2d array to grid index

moraine bool2gix --is_pc STR --gix STR [--chunks VALUE]
​参数​ ​类型​ ​默认值​ ​说明​ --is_pc str ​必需​ input bool array --gix str ​必需​ output, point cloud grid index --chunks int 100000 output point chunk size

​全局​选项​：--json、--traceback、--log FILE、-q / --quiet（​约定​）。

​在​ pipeline ​文件​中​（​示例​ pipeline ​未​使用​此​命令​；​只列​必需​参数​）：

[[step]]
name = "bool2gix"
run = "bool2gix"
is_pc = "..."
gix = "..."

​在​ Python ​中​：

import moraine.cli as mc
mc.bool2gix(is_pc, gix, chunks=100000)

docs.title: ras2pc
docs.text:
Convert raster data to point cloud data

moraine ras2pc --idx STR --ras PATH [PATH ...] --pc PATH [PATH ...] [--chunks VALUE] [--processes | --no-processes] [--n_workers VALUE] [--threads_per_worker VALUE]
​参数​ ​类型​ ​默认值​ ​说明​ --idx str ​必需​ input grid index or hillbert index of the point cloud --ras str | list ​必需​ input path or list of paths of raster data, shape (nlines, width, ...) --pc str | list ​必需​ output, path (in string) or list of path for point cloud data --chunks int None point chunk size of the output data, same as idx by default --processes False use processes for the workers instead of threads --n_workers 1 number of workers --threads_per_worker 4 tasks a worker runs at the same time

​全局​选项​：--json、--traceback、--log FILE、-q / --quiet（​约定​）。

​在​ pipeline ​文件​中​（examples/02_ps.toml，​步骤​ ps_can_data）：

[[step]]
name = "ps_can_data"
run = "ras2pc"
idx = "ps/ps_can_hix.zarr"
ras = ["raw/rslc.zarr", "raw/e.zarr", "raw/n.zarr", "raw/lon.zarr", "raw/lat.zarr", "ps/ras_adi.zarr"]
pc = ["ps/ps_can_rslc.zarr", "ps/ps_can_e.zarr", "ps/ps_can_n.zarr", "ps/ps_can_lon.zarr", "ps/ps_can_lat.zarr", "ps/ps_can_adi.zarr"]

​也​用于​ examples/03_ds.toml（​步骤​ ds_en）, examples/04_refine.toml（​步骤​ lon_lat）, examples/04_refine.toml（​步骤​ geometry）。

​在​ Python ​中​：

import moraine.cli as mc
mc.ras2pc(idx, ras, pc, chunks=None, processes=False, n_workers=1, threads_per_worker=4)

​数组​函数​ mr.ras2pc ​对​内存​中​的​ numpy / cupy ​数组​做​同样​的​事​。

docs.title: pc-concat
docs.text:
concatenate (and sort) point cloud dataset.

moraine pc-concat --pcs PATH [PATH ...] --pc PATH [PATH ...] [--key PATH [PATH ...]] [--chunks VALUE] [--processes | --no-processes] [--n_workers VALUE] [--threads_per_worker VALUE]
​参数​ ​类型​ ​默认值​ ​说明​ --pcs list | str ​必需​ list of path to pc or directory that hold one pc, or a list of that --pc list | str ​必需​ output, path of output or a list of that --key list | str None input key(s) that sort the concatenated data (e.g. from ras2pc_ras_chunk); no sorting by default --chunks int None pc chunk size in output data, optional, same as first pc in pcs by default --processes False use processes for the workers instead of threads --n_workers 1 number of workers --threads_per_worker 4 tasks a worker runs at the same time

​全局​选项​：--json、--traceback、--log FILE、-q / --quiet（​约定​）。

​在​ pipeline ​文件​中​（examples/03_ds.toml，​步骤​ ds_can_concat）：

[[step]]
name = "ds_can_concat"            # chunks -> one array each, in hilbert order
run = "pc-concat"
pcs = ["ds/chunks/ds_can_ph", "ds/chunks/ds_can_t_coh", "ds/chunks/ds_can_t_coh_w", "ds/chunks/ds_can_n_components"]
pc = ["ds/ds_can_ph.zarr", "ds/ds_can_t_coh.zarr", "ds/ds_can_t_coh_w.zarr", "ds/ds_can_n_components.zarr"]
key = ["ds/chunks/ds_can_key.zarr", "ds/chunks/gix2hix_key.zarr"]
chunks = 200000

​在​ Python ​中​：

import moraine.cli as mc
mc.pc_concat(pcs, pc, key=None, chunks=None, processes=False, n_workers=1, threads_per_worker=4)

docs.title: ras2pc-ras-chunk
docs.text:
Convert raster data to point cloud data that sorted by ras chunk

moraine ras2pc-ras-chunk --gix STR --ras PATH [PATH ...] --pc PATH [PATH ...] --key STR [--chunks INT INT] [--processes | --no-processes] [--n_workers VALUE] [--threads_per_worker VALUE]
​参数​ ​类型​ ​默认值​ ​说明​ --gix str ​必需​ input grid index (azimuth, range) of the point cloud, shape (n_points, 2), int --ras str | list ​必需​ input path or list of paths of raster data, shape (nlines, width, ...) --pc str | list ​必需​ output, path (directory) or list of path for point cloud data --key str ​必需​ output, path for the key to sort generated pc in the directory back to gix order --chunks tuple[int, int] None (azimuth, range) raster chunk size used to split the points, same as the first ras by default --processes False use processes for the workers instead of threads --n_workers 1 number of workers --threads_per_worker 4 tasks a worker runs at the same time

​全局​选项​：--json、--traceback、--log FILE、-q / --quiet（​约定​）。

​在​ pipeline ​文件​中​（examples/03_ds.toml，​步骤​ ds_can_is_shp）：

[[step]]
name = "ds_can_is_shp"            # SHPs of the candidates, one zarr per raster chunk
run = "ras2pc-ras-chunk"
gix = "ds/ds_can_gix_ras_order.zarr"
ras = "ds/ras_is_shp.zarr"
pc = "ds/chunks/ds_can_is_shp"
key = "ds/chunks/ds_can_key.zarr"
chunks = [1000, 1000]

​在​ Python ​中​：

import moraine.cli as mc
mc.ras2pc_ras_chunk(gix, ras, pc, key, chunks=None, processes=False, n_workers=1, threads_per_worker=4)

docs.title: pc2ras
docs.text:
Convert point cloud data to raster data, filled with nan

moraine pc2ras --idx STR --pc PATH [PATH ...] --ras PATH [PATH ...] --shape INT INT [--chunks INT INT] [--processes | --no-processes] [--n_workers VALUE] [--threads_per_worker VALUE]
​参数​ ​类型​ ​默认值​ ​说明​ --idx str ​必需​ input grid index or hillbert index of the point cloud --pc str | list ​必需​ input path or list of paths of point cloud data, shape (n_points, ...) --ras str | list ​必需​ output, path (in string) or list of path for raster data --shape tuple[int, int] ​必需​ shape of one image (nlines,width) --chunks tuple[int, int], 1000) (1000, 1000) output chunk size --processes False use processes for the workers instead of threads --n_workers 1 number of workers --threads_per_worker 4 tasks a worker runs at the same time

​全局​选项​：--json、--traceback、--log FILE、-q / --quiet（​约定​）。

​在​ pipeline ​文件​中​（​示例​ pipeline ​未​使用​此​命令​；​只列​必需​参数​）：

[[step]]
name = "pc2ras"
run = "pc2ras"
idx = "..."
pc = "..."
ras = "..."
shape = "..."

​在​ Python ​中​：

import moraine.cli as mc
mc.pc2ras(idx, pc, ras, shape, chunks=(1000, 1000), processes=False, n_workers=1, threads_per_worker=4)

​数组​函数​ mr.pc2ras ​对​内存​中​的​ numpy / cupy ​数组​做​同样​的​事​。

docs.title: pc-hix
docs.text:
Compute the hillbert index from grid index for point cloud data.

moraine pc-hix --gix STR --hix STR --shape INT INT
​参数​ ​类型​ ​默认值​ ​说明​ --gix str ​必需​ input grid index (azimuth, range) of the point cloud, shape (n_points, 2), int --hix str ​必需​ output hillbert index of the point cloud, shape (n_points,), int64 --shape tuple[int, int] ​必需​ raster shape (nlines, width)

​全局​选项​：--json、--traceback、--log FILE、-q / --quiet（​约定​）。

​在​ pipeline ​文件​中​（examples/02_ps.toml，​步骤​ ps_can_hix）：

[[step]]
name = "ps_can_hix"
run = "pc-hix"
gix = "ps/ps_can_gix.zarr"
hix = "ps/ps_can_hix_unsorted.zarr"
shape = "${shape}"

​也​用于​ examples/03_ds.toml（​步骤​ ds_can_hix）。

​在​ Python ​中​：

import moraine.cli as mc
mc.pc_hix(gix, hix, shape)

​数组​函数​ mr.pc_hix ​对​内存​中​的​ numpy / cupy ​数组​做​同样​的​事​。

docs.title: pc-gix
docs.text:
Compute the grid index from hillbert index for point cloud data.

moraine pc-gix --hix STR --gix STR --shape INT INT
​参数​ ​类型​ ​默认值​ ​说明​ --hix str ​必需​ input hillbert index of the point cloud, shape (n_points,), int64 --gix str ​必需​ output grid index (azimuth, range) of the point cloud, shape (n_points, 2), int --shape tuple[int, int] ​必需​ raster shape (nlines, width)

​全局​选项​：--json、--traceback、--log FILE、-q / --quiet（​约定​）。

​在​ pipeline ​文件​中​（examples/05_unwrap.toml，​步骤​ gix）：

[[step]]
name = "gix"                      # mcf-pc needs the grid index of the points
run = "pc-gix"
hix = "pc/pc_hix.zarr"
gix = "unw/pc_gix.zarr"
shape = "${shape}"

​在​ Python ​中​：

import moraine.cli as mc
mc.pc_gix(hix, gix, shape)

​数组​函数​ mr.pc_gix ​对​内存​中​的​ numpy / cupy ​数组​做​同样​的​事​。

docs.title: pc-sort
docs.text:
Sort point cloud data according to the indices that sort idx_in.

moraine pc-sort --idx_in STR --idx STR [--pc_in PATH [PATH ...]] [--pc PATH [PATH ...]] [--shape INT INT] [--chunks VALUE] [--key STR] [--processes | --no-processes] [--n_workers VALUE] [--threads_per_worker VALUE]
​参数​ ​类型​ ​默认值​ ​说明​ --idx_in str ​必需​ input unsorted grid index or hillbert index of the input data --idx str ​必需​ output, the sorted grid index or hillbert index --pc_in str | list None input path or list of paths of the input point cloud data --pc str | list None output, path (in string) or list of path for the output point cloud data --shape tuple[int, int] None (nline, width), faster if provided for grid index input --chunks int None chunk size in output data, same as idx_in by default --key str None output, path (in string) for the key of sorting --processes False use processes for the workers instead of threads --n_workers 1 number of workers --threads_per_worker 4 tasks a worker runs at the same time

​全局​选项​：--json、--traceback、--log FILE、-q / --quiet（​约定​）。

​在​ pipeline ​文件​中​（examples/02_ps.toml，​步骤​ ps_can_sort）：

[[step]]
name = "ps_can_sort"              # hilbert order
run = "pc-sort"
idx_in = "ps/ps_can_hix_unsorted.zarr"
idx = "ps/ps_can_hix.zarr"

​也​用于​ examples/03_ds.toml（​步骤​ ds_can_sort）。

​在​ Python ​中​：

import moraine.cli as mc
mc.pc_sort(idx_in, idx, pc_in=None, pc=None, shape=None, chunks=None, key=None, processes=False, n_workers=1, threads_per_worker=4)

​数组​函数​ mr.pc_sort ​对​内存​中​的​ numpy / cupy ​数组​做​同样​的​事​。

docs.title: pc-union
docs.text:
Get the union of two point cloud datasets. Points in both keep the data of the first point cloud.

moraine pc-union --idx1 STR --idx2 STR --idx STR [--pc1 PATH [PATH ...]] [--pc2 PATH [PATH ...]] [--pc PATH [PATH ...]] [--shape INT INT] [--chunks VALUE] [--processes | --no-processes] [--n_workers VALUE] [--threads_per_worker VALUE]
​参数​ ​类型​ ​默认值​ ​说明​ --idx1 str ​必需​ input grid index or hillbert index of the first point cloud, sorted --idx2 str ​必需​ input grid index or hillbert index of the second point cloud, sorted --idx str ​必需​ output grid index or hillbert index of the union --pc1 str | list None input path or list of paths of the first point cloud data --pc2 str | list None input path or list of paths of the second point cloud data --pc str | list None output path or list of paths of the point cloud data of the union --shape tuple[int, int] None image shape, faster if provided for grid index input --chunks int None point chunk size of the output data, same as idx1 by default --processes False use processes for the workers instead of threads --n_workers 1 number of workers --threads_per_worker 4 tasks a worker runs at the same time

​全局​选项​：--json、--traceback、--log FILE、-q / --quiet（​约定​）。

​在​ pipeline ​文件​中​（examples/02_ps.toml，​步骤​ ps_can）：

[[step]]
name = "ps_can"                   # union of both candidate sets
run = "pc-union"
idx1 = "ps/ps_can_1_gix.zarr"
idx2 = "ps/ps_can_2_gix.zarr"
idx = "ps/ps_can_gix.zarr"
shape = "${shape}"

​也​用于​ examples/04_refine.toml（​步骤​ merge）。

​在​ Python ​中​：

import moraine.cli as mc
mc.pc_union(idx1, idx2, idx, pc1=None, pc2=None, pc=None, shape=None, chunks=None, processes=False, n_workers=1, threads_per_worker=4)

​数组​函数​ mr.pc_union ​对​内存​中​的​ numpy / cupy ​数组​做​同样​的​事​。

docs.title: pc-intersect
docs.text:
Get the intersection of two point cloud datasets.

moraine pc-intersect --idx1 STR --idx2 STR --idx STR [--pc1 PATH [PATH ...]] [--pc2 PATH [PATH ...]] [--pc PATH [PATH ...]] [--shape INT INT] [--chunks VALUE] [--prefer_1 | --no-prefer_1] [--processes | --no-processes] [--n_workers VALUE] [--threads_per_worker VALUE]
​参数​ ​类型​ ​默认值​ ​说明​ --idx1 str ​必需​ input grid index or hillbert index of the first point cloud, sorted --idx2 str ​必需​ input grid index or hillbert index of the second point cloud, sorted --idx str ​必需​ output grid index or hillbert index of the intersection --pc1 str | list None input path or list of paths of the first point cloud data --pc2 str | list None input path or list of paths of the second point cloud data --pc str | list None output path or list of paths of the point cloud data of the intersection, taken from pc1 or pc2 (see prefer_1) --shape tuple[int, int] None image shape, faster if provided for grid index input --chunks int None point chunk size of the output data, same as idx1 by default --prefer_1 bool True take the output data from pc1 (True) or from pc2 (False) --processes False use processes for the workers instead of threads --n_workers 1 number of workers --threads_per_worker 4 tasks a worker runs at the same time

​全局​选项​：--json、--traceback、--log FILE、-q / --quiet（​约定​）。

​在​ pipeline ​文件​中​（​示例​ pipeline ​未​使用​此​命令​；​只列​必需​参数​）：

[[step]]
name = "pc_intersect"
run = "pc-intersect"
idx1 = "..."
idx2 = "..."
idx = "..."

​在​ Python ​中​：

import moraine.cli as mc
mc.pc_intersect(idx1, idx2, idx, pc1=None, pc2=None, pc=None, shape=None, chunks=None, prefer_1=True, processes=False, n_workers=1, threads_per_worker=4)

​数组​函数​ mr.pc_intersect ​对​内存​中​的​ numpy / cupy ​数组​做​同样​的​事​。

docs.title: pc-diff
docs.text:
Get the points of the first point cloud dataset that are not in the second one.

moraine pc-diff --idx1 STR --idx2 STR --idx STR [--pc1 PATH [PATH ...]] [--pc PATH [PATH ...]] [--shape INT INT] [--chunks VALUE] [--processes | --no-processes] [--n_workers VALUE] [--threads_per_worker VALUE]
​参数​ ​类型​ ​默认值​ ​说明​ --idx1 str ​必需​ input grid index or hillbert index of the first point cloud, sorted --idx2 str ​必需​ input grid index or hillbert index of the second point cloud, sorted --idx str ​必需​ output grid index or hillbert index of the points in idx1 but not in idx2 --pc1 str | list None input path or list of paths of the first point cloud data --pc str | list None output path or list of paths of the point cloud data of these points, taken from pc1 --shape tuple[int, int] None image shape, faster if provided for grid index input --chunks int None point chunk size of the output data, same as idx1 by default --processes False use processes for the workers instead of threads --n_workers 1 number of workers --threads_per_worker 4 tasks a worker runs at the same time

​全局​选项​：--json、--traceback、--log FILE、-q / --quiet（​约定​）。

​在​ pipeline ​文件​中​（​示例​ pipeline ​未​使用​此​命令​；​只列​必需​参数​）：

[[step]]
name = "pc_diff"
run = "pc-diff"
idx1 = "..."
idx2 = "..."
idx = "..."

​在​ Python ​中​：

import moraine.cli as mc
mc.pc_diff(idx1, idx2, idx, pc1=None, pc=None, shape=None, chunks=None, processes=False, n_workers=1, threads_per_worker=4)

​数组​函数​ mr.pc_diff ​对​内存​中​的​ numpy / cupy ​数组​做​同样​的​事​。

docs.title: pc-logic-ras
docs.text:
generate point cloud index based on logical operation of one raster image.

moraine pc-logic-ras --ras VALUE --gix VALUE --operation STR [--chunks VALUE]
​参数​ ​类型​ ​默认值​ ​说明​ --ras ​必需​ input raster used in operation, shape (nlines, width) --gix ​必需​ output grid index (azimuth, range) of the point cloud, shape (n_points, 2), int, of the pixels where operation is True --operation str ​必需​ numexpr expression on the raster, which is named ras, e.g. '(ras>=0)&(ras<=0.3)' --chunks int 100000 chunk size in output data, optional

​全局​选项​：--json、--traceback、--log FILE、-q / --quiet（​约定​）。

​在​ pipeline ​文件​中​（examples/02_ps.toml，​步骤​ ps_can_adi）：

[[step]]
name = "ps_can_adi"               # candidates 1: ADI below 0.4
run = "pc-logic-ras"
ras = "ps/ras_adi.zarr"
gix = "ps/ps_can_1_gix.zarr"
operation = "ras<0.4"
chunks = 200000

​也​用于​ examples/02_ps.toml（​步骤​ ps_can_n2f）, examples/03_ds.toml（​步骤​ ds_can）。

​在​ Python ​中​：

import moraine.cli as mc
mc.pc_logic_ras(ras, gix, operation, chunks=100000)

docs.title: pc-logic-pc
docs.text:
generate point cloud index and data based on logical operation one point cloud data.

moraine pc-logic-pc --idx_in STR --pc_in STR --idx STR --operation STR [--chunks VALUE]
​参数​ ​类型​ ​默认值​ ​说明​ --idx_in str ​必需​ input grid index or hillbert index of the input point cloud --pc_in str ​必需​ input point cloud data used in operation, shape (n_points,) --idx str ​必需​ output grid index or hillbert index of the points where operation is True --operation str ​必需​ numexpr expression on the point cloud data, which is named pc_in, e.g. '(pc_in>=0.1)&(pc_in<=0.5)' --chunks int None point chunk size of the output data, same as idx_in by default

​全局​选项​：--json、--traceback、--log FILE、-q / --quiet（​约定​）。

​在​ pipeline ​文件​中​（examples/03_ds.toml，​步骤​ ds_connected）：

[[step]]
name = "ds_connected"             # one connected component
run = "pc-logic-pc"
idx_in = "ds/ds_can_hix.zarr"
pc_in = "ds/ds_can_n_components.zarr"
idx = "ds/ds_connected_hix.zarr"
operation = "pc_in==1"

​也​用于​ examples/03_ds.toml（​步骤​ ds）, examples/04_refine.toml（​步骤​ select）。

​在​ Python ​中​：

import moraine.cli as mc
mc.pc_logic_pc(idx_in, pc_in, idx, operation, chunks=None)

docs.title: pc-select-data
docs.text:
generate point cloud data based on its index and one point cloud data. The index of generated point cloud data must in the index of the old one.

moraine pc-select-data --idx_in STR --idx STR --pc_in PATH [PATH ...] --pc PATH [PATH ...] [--shape INT INT] [--chunks VALUE] [--processes | --no-processes] [--n_workers VALUE] [--threads_per_worker VALUE]
​参数​ ​类型​ ​默认值​ ​说明​ --idx_in str ​必需​ input grid index or hillbert index of the input point cloud, sorted --idx str ​必需​ input grid index or hillbert index of the points to select, a subset of idx_in, sorted --pc_in str | list ​必需​ input path or list of paths of the input point cloud data --pc str | list ​必需​ output, path (in string) or list of path for the output point cloud data --shape tuple[int, int] None shape of the raster data the point cloud from, must be provided if idx is hix --chunks int None point chunk size of the output data, same as idx by default --processes False use processes for the workers instead of threads --n_workers 1 number of workers --threads_per_worker 4 tasks a worker runs at the same time

​全局​选项​：--json、--traceback、--log FILE、-q / --quiet（​约定​）。

​在​ pipeline ​文件​中​（examples/03_ds.toml，​步骤​ ds_connected_t_coh_w）：

[[step]]
name = "ds_connected_t_coh_w"     # the weighted temporal coherence of those points
run = "pc-select-data"
idx_in = "ds/ds_can_hix.zarr"
idx = "ds/ds_connected_hix.zarr"
pc_in = ["ds/ds_can_t_coh_w.zarr"]
pc = ["ds/ds_connected_t_coh_w.zarr"]

​也​用于​ examples/03_ds.toml（​步骤​ ds_data）, examples/04_refine.toml（​步骤​ select_data）。

​在​ Python ​中​：

import moraine.cli as mc
mc.pc_select_data(idx_in, idx, pc_in, pc, shape=None, chunks=None, processes=False, n_workers=1, threads_per_worker=4)

docs.title: pl: Phase linking (CLI)
docs.text:
moraine.cli.pl ​的​命令​（​源码​）；​同样​的​函数​在​ Python ​里​以​ mc.<name>(...) ​调用​（import moraine.cli as mc）。​下面​的​帮助​由​ docstring ​生成​，​与​ moraine COMMAND --help ​相同​（docstring ​为​英文​）。

​命令​ ​摘要​ emi Phase linking with EMI estimator. ds-temp-coh DS temporal coherence, optionally also weighted by the coherence of the image pairs. emperical-co-emi-temp-coh-pc estimating emperical coherence matrix, phase linking and estimating temporal coherence on point cloud data.

docs.title: emi
docs.text:
Phase linking with EMI estimator.

moraine emi --coh STR --ph STR [--ref VALUE] [--regularize | --no-regularize] [--chunks INT INT] [--cuda | --no-cuda] [--processes VALUE] [--n_workers VALUE] [--threads_per_worker VALUE]
​参数​ ​类型​ ​默认值​ ​说明​ --coh str ​必需​ input complex coherence of the points (upper triangle of the coherence matrix), shape (n_points, n_image_pairs) --ph str ​必需​ output phase history of the points, complex, shape (n_points, nimages) --ref int 0 index of the reference image, its phase is set to 0 --regularize bool True regularize the coherence matrix of the points whose coherence magnitude matrix is not positive definite or numerically singular (e.g. when the number of images approaches the number of independent looks of the SHPs; without it their phase history is not reliable); points with a well conditioned positive definite matrix are not changed --chunks int None point chunk size of the output data, same as coh by default --cuda bool False if use cuda for processing, false by default --processes None use processes (True) or threads (False) for the workers, only for cpu processing. Default: False --n_workers None number of workers. Default: 1 for cpu, one per GPU for cuda --threads_per_worker None tasks a worker runs at the same time. Default: 2

​全局​选项​：--json、--traceback、--log FILE、-q / --quiet（​约定​）。

​在​ pipeline ​文件​中​（​示例​ pipeline ​未​使用​此​命令​；​只列​必需​参数​）：

[[step]]
name = "emi"
run = "emi"
coh = "..."
ph = "..."

​在​ Python ​中​：

import moraine.cli as mc
mc.emi(coh, ph, ref=0, regularize=True, chunks=None, cuda=False, processes=None, n_workers=None, threads_per_worker=None)

​数组​函数​ mr.emi ​对​内存​中​的​ numpy / cupy ​数组​做​同样​的​事​。

docs.title: ds-temp-coh
docs.text:
DS temporal coherence, optionally also weighted by the coherence of the image pairs.

moraine ds-temp-coh --coh STR --ph STR [--t_coh STR] [--tnet STR] [--n_looks STR] [--t_coh_w STR] [--eff_n_pairs STR] [--n_components STR] [--alpha VALUE] [--chunks INT INT] [--cuda | --no-cuda] [--processes VALUE] [--n_workers VALUE] [--threads_per_worker VALUE]
​参数​ ​类型​ ​默认值​ ​说明​ --coh str ​必需​ input complex coherence of the points (upper triangle of the coherence matrix), shape (n_points, n_image_pairs) --ph str ​必需​ input phase history of the points, complex, shape (n_points, nimages) --t_coh str None output temporal coherence of the points, every image pair weighted the same, shape (n_points,) --tnet str None input path of a saved TempNet with the image pairs of coh; all image pairs by default --n_looks str None input effective number of independent looks of the coherence of the points, float32, shape (n_points,), in the order of coh: the merged n_looks_dir of emperical-co-pc; needed by t_coh_w and eff_n_pairs --t_coh_w str None output weighted temporal coherence of the points, float32, shape (n_points,), 0..1: the image pairs weighted by their squared coherence without the noise bias, so that incoherent pairs (e.g. long time spans in vegetation) do not lower it; NaN where no image pair is above the noise level --eff_n_pairs str None output effective number of image pairs the weighted temporal coherence rests on, float32, shape (n_points,), 0..n_image_pairs; a high weighted temporal coherence of few effective pairs is not reliable --n_components str None output number of connected components of the graph whose nodes are the images and whose edges are the coherent image pairs, int16, shape (n_points,), 1..nimages; 1 means every image is linked to every other by coherent pairs, with more the phase between the groups of images is not constrained by any coherent pair, whatever the weighted temporal coherence is; needs n_looks --alpha float 0.001 probability that a point without any coherent image pair (pure noise) has all images connected (n_components 1); it sets the squared coherence above which an image pair counts as coherent, depending on the number of looks and of images; 1e-6 <= alpha <= 0.5; only with n_looks --chunks int None point cloud chunk size, same as coh by default --cuda bool False if use cuda for processing, false by default --processes None use processes (True) or threads (False) for the workers, only for cpu processing. Default: False --n_workers None number of workers. Default: 1 for cpu, one per GPU for cuda --threads_per_worker None tasks a worker runs at the same time. Default: 2

​全局​选项​：--json、--traceback、--log FILE、-q / --quiet（​约定​）。

​在​ pipeline ​文件​中​（​示例​ pipeline ​未​使用​此​命令​；​只列​必需​参数​）：

[[step]]
name = "ds_temp_coh"
run = "ds-temp-coh"
coh = "..."
ph = "..."

​在​ Python ​中​：

import moraine.cli as mc
mc.ds_temp_coh(coh, ph, t_coh=None, tnet=None, n_looks=None, t_coh_w=None, eff_n_pairs=None, n_components=None, alpha=0.001, chunks=None, cuda=False, processes=None, n_workers=None, threads_per_worker=None)

​数组​函数​ mr.ds_temp_coh ​对​内存​中​的​ numpy / cupy ​数组​做​同样​的​事​。

docs.title: emperical-co-emi-temp-coh-pc
docs.text:
estimating emperical coherence matrix, phase linking and estimating temporal coherence on point cloud data.

moraine emperical-co-emi-temp-coh-pc --rslc STR --is_shp_dir STR --gix STR --ph_dir STR --t_coh_dir STR [--t_coh_w_dir STR] [--eff_n_pairs_dir STR] [--n_components_dir STR] [--alpha VALUE] [--batch_size VALUE] [--regularize | --no-regularize] [--chunks INT INT] [--cuda | --no-cuda] [--processes VALUE] [--n_workers VALUE] [--threads_per_worker VALUE]
​参数​ ​类型​ ​默认值​ ​说明​ --rslc str ​必需​ input rslc stack, shape (nlines, width, nimages) --is_shp_dir str ​必需​ input directory with the SHP bool arrays of the points, one zarr per raster chunk, made by ras2pc_ras_chunk --gix str ​必需​ input grid index of the point cloud (azimuth, range), shape (n_points, 2), int --ph_dir str ​必需​ output directory with the phase history of the points, complex, shape (n_points, nimages), one zarr per raster chunk; merge with pc_concat and the key of ras2pc_ras_chunk --t_coh_dir str ​必需​ output directory with the temporal coherence of the points, shape (n_points,), one zarr per raster chunk --t_coh_w_dir str None output directory with the weighted temporal coherence of the points (see ds-temp-coh), shape (n_points,), float32, 0..1, NaN where no image pair is above the noise level, one zarr per raster chunk; the effective number of looks of each point comes from the positions of its SHPs and the speckle correlation of rslc --eff_n_pairs_dir str None output directory with the effective number of image pairs of the weighted temporal coherence, shape (n_points,), float32, one zarr per raster chunk; a high weighted temporal coherence of few effective pairs is not reliable --n_components_dir str None output directory with the number of connected components of the graph whose nodes are the images and whose edges are the coherent image pairs (see ds-temp-coh), shape (n_points,), int16, 1..nimages, one zarr per raster chunk; 1 means every image is linked to every other by coherent pairs --alpha float 0.001 probability that a point without any coherent image pair (pure noise) has all images connected; 1e-6 <= alpha <= 0.5; see ds-temp-coh; only with one of the weighted outputs --batch_size int None number of points a worker processes at once; the coherence matrices of a batch take 8 bytes per image pair and point, their estimation on the GPU up to 1 GiB more. Default: as many points as 1 GiB of coherence matrices hold (small batches cost time: thousands of small GPU operations per batch) --regularize bool True regularize the coherence matrix in the phase linking as regularize of emi; the temporal coherence is computed with the coherence matrix as estimated --chunks tuple[int, int] None parallel processing (azimuth, range) chunk size. Default: rslc.chunks[:2] --cuda bool False if use cuda for processing, false by default --processes None use processes (True) or threads (False) for the workers, only for cpu processing. Default: False --n_workers None number of workers. Default: 1 for cpu, one per GPU for cuda --threads_per_worker None tasks a worker runs at the same time. Default: 2

​全局​选项​：--json、--traceback、--log FILE、-q / --quiet（​约定​）。

​在​ pipeline ​文件​中​（examples/03_ds.toml，​步骤​ phase_linking）：

[[step]]
name = "phase_linking"
run = "emperical-co-emi-temp-coh-pc"
rslc = "raw/rslc.zarr"
is_shp_dir = "ds/chunks/ds_can_is_shp"
gix = "ds/ds_can_gix_ras_order.zarr"
ph_dir = "ds/chunks/ds_can_ph"
t_coh_dir = "ds/chunks/ds_can_t_coh"
t_coh_w_dir = "ds/chunks/ds_can_t_coh_w"
n_components_dir = "ds/chunks/ds_can_n_components"
alpha = 1e-3                      # a point without any coherent image pair has all images connected with this probability
chunks = [1000, 1000]

# ---- hilbert order

​在​ Python ​中​：

import moraine.cli as mc
mc.emperical_co_emi_temp_coh_pc(rslc, is_shp_dir, gix, ph_dir, t_coh_dir, t_coh_w_dir=None, eff_n_pairs_dir=None, n_components_dir=None, alpha=0.001, batch_size=None, regularize=True, chunks=None, cuda=False, processes=None, n_workers=None, threads_per_worker=None)

​数组​函数​ mr.emperical_co_emi_temp_coh_pc ​对​内存​中​的​ numpy / cupy ​数组​做​同样​的​事​。

docs.text:
moraine.cli.plot ​的​命令​（​源码​）；​同样​的​函数​在​ Python ​里​以​ mc.<name>(...) ​调用​（import moraine.cli as mc）。​下面​的​帮助​由​ docstring ​生成​，​与​ moraine COMMAND --help ​相同​（docstring ​为​英文​）。

​命令​ ​摘要​ ras-pyramid render raster data to pyramid of difference zoom levels. pc-pyramid render point cloud data to pyramid of difference zoom levels.

docs.title: ras-pyramid
docs.text:
render raster data to pyramid of difference zoom levels.

moraine ras-pyramid --ras STR --out_dir STR [--chunks INT INT] [--rows VALUE] [--method STR] [--n_workers VALUE]
​参数​ ​类型​ ​默认值​ ​说明​ --ras str ​必需​ input 2D raster (nlines, width) or raster stack (nlines, width, n) --out_dir str ​必需​ output directory to store rendered data --chunks tuple[int, int], 256) (256, 256) output raster tile size --rows int 1024 lines of the raster a process reads at a time, a power of 2; a process needs about 1 GB plus 3 x rows x width x itemsize bytes --method str 'decimate' how each level is made from the finer one: 'decimate' keeps every 2nd pixel, 'mean' averages the 2 x 2 blocks (nan pixels left out, complex data as complex numbers; integer and boolean data give float32 levels). The mean is a multilook of the data: right for real values and for phases relative to a reference image (phase histories of phase linking, filtered interferograms), wrong for the SLC pixels of an rslc stack, whose scatterer phases differ from pixel to pixel --n_workers int None processes rendering the channels at the same time, default: 8 or the number of cores if fewer; a process renders one channel of the raster

​全局​选项​：--json、--traceback、--log FILE、-q / --quiet（​约定​）。

​在​ pipeline ​文件​中​（examples/01_load.toml，​步骤​ rslc_pyramid）：

[[step]]
name = "rslc_pyramid"             # to check the interferograms: moraine quicklook raw/rslc_pyramid --show intf_seq
                                  # decimated (SLC pixels cannot be averaged): zoom in, the whole scene is speckle
run = "ras-pyramid"
ras = "raw/rslc.zarr"
out_dir = "raw/rslc_pyramid"

​也​用于​ examples/02_ps.toml（​步骤​ adi_pyramid）, examples/02_ps.toml（​步骤​ n2f_intf_pyramid）, examples/02_ps.toml（​步骤​ temp_coh_pyramid）, examples/03_ds.toml（​步骤​ shp_num_pyramid）。

​在​ Python ​中​：

import moraine.cli as mc
mc.ras_pyramid(ras, out_dir, chunks=(256, 256), rows=1024, method='decimate', n_workers=None)

docs.title: pc-pyramid
docs.text:
render point cloud data to pyramid of difference zoom levels.

moraine pc-pyramid --pc STR --out_dir STR [--x STR] [--y STR] [--yx STR] [--ras_resolution VALUE] [--ras_chunks INT INT] [--pc_chunks VALUE] [--method STR] [--n_workers VALUE]
​参数​ ​类型​ ​默认值​ ​说明​ --pc str ​必需​ input point cloud data, shape (n_points,) or (n_points, n) --out_dir str ​必需​ output directory to store rendered data --x str None input x coordinate of the points, e.g. longitude or web mercator x --y str None input y coordinate of the points, e.g. latitude or web mercator y --yx str None input (y, x) coordinates of the points, shape (n_points, 2), e.g. gix; alternative to x and y --ras_resolution float 20 minimum resolution of rendered raster data, --ras_chunks tuple[int, int], 256) (256, 256) output raster tile size --pc_chunks int 65536 output pc tile size --method str 'first' how each level is made from the finer one: 'first' keeps the first cell with a point of each 2 x 2 block, 'mean' averages the cells with points (complex data as complex numbers). The mean is a multilook of the data: right for real values and for phase histories relative to a reference image (phase linking, filtered points) --n_workers int None processes rendering the channels at the same time, default: 8 or the number of cores if fewer; a process holds one channel: the data of the points and the finest raster of the channel (3 rasters with 'mean')

​全局​选项​：--json、--traceback、--log FILE、-q / --quiet（​约定​）。

​在​ pipeline ​文件​中​（examples/02_ps.toml，​步骤​ ps_can_pyramid）：

[[step]]
name = "ps_can_pyramid"           # ADI of the candidates on the map
run = "pc-pyramid"
pc = "ps/ps_can_adi.zarr"
out_dir = "ps/ps_can_adi_pyramid"
method = "mean"
x = "ps/ps_can_e.zarr"
y = "ps/ps_can_n.zarr"
ras_resolution = 20

​也​用于​ examples/03_ds.toml（​步骤​ ds_can_t_coh_w_pyramid）, examples/03_ds.toml（​步骤​ ds_can_n_components_pyramid）, examples/03_ds.toml（​步骤​ ds_ph_pyramid）, examples/04_refine.toml（​步骤​ temp_coh_pyramid）, examples/04_refine.toml（​步骤​ pc_ph_pyramid）, examples/05_unwrap.toml（​步骤​ unw_pyramid）。

​在​ Python ​中​：

import moraine.cli as mc
mc.pc_pyramid(pc, out_dir, x=None, y=None, yx=None, ras_resolution=20, ras_chunks=(256, 256), pc_chunks=65536, method='first', n_workers=None)

​命令​ ​摘要​ polygon-mask Mask of the pixels or points inside (or outside) the polygons of a GeoJSON file

docs.title: polygon-mask
docs.text:
Mask of the pixels or points inside (or outside) the polygons of a GeoJSON file. The polygons come from the tile viewer (TileView.save_polygons) or any GeoJSON file. Give the positions of the data in the coordinates of the file in one of three ways: x and y (longitude / latitude for 'lonlat' files, range / azimuth for 'radar_grid' files), gix (point clouds on the radar grid) or shape (a whole raster on the radar grid, pixel (i, j) at range j, azimuth i). Apply the mask with e.g. math (where(mask, a, nan)) or pc-logic-pc.

moraine polygon-mask --polygons STR --mask STR [--x STR] [--y STR] [--gix STR] [--shape INT INT] [--keep STR] [--chunks INT INT]
​参数​ ​类型​ ​默认值​ ​说明​ --polygons str ​必需​ input GeoJSON file with the polygons --mask str ​必需​ output bool mask, True for the data to keep; same shape as x / y, (n_points,) for gix, (nlines, width) for shape --x str None input x coordinate of the data (longitude or range), any shape; with y --y str None input y coordinate of the data (latitude or azimuth), same shape as x --gix str None input grid index (azimuth, range) of a point cloud, shape (n_points, 2); 'radar_grid' polygons only --shape tuple[int, int] None raster shape (nlines, width); 'radar_grid' polygons only --keep str 'inside' 'inside' keeps the data inside any polygon (True there), 'outside' keeps the data outside all polygons --chunks tuple[int, int], 1000) (1000, 1000) output chunk size for shape; the other outputs are chunked like their input

​全局​选项​：--json、--traceback、--log FILE、-q / --quiet（​约定​）。

​在​ pipeline ​文件​中​（​示例​ pipeline ​未​使用​此​命令​；​只列​必需​参数​）：

[[step]]
name = "polygon_mask"
run = "polygon-mask"
polygons = "..."
mask = "..."

​在​ Python ​中​：

import moraine.cli as mc
mc.polygon_mask(polygons, mask, x=None, y=None, gix=None, shape=None, keep='inside', chunks=(1000, 1000))

docs.title: gamma-mcf-pt
docs.text:
A wrapper for mcf_pt in GAMMA software.

moraine gamma-mcf-pt --pc_x STR --pc_y STR --ph STR --unw_ph STR --image_pairs FILE [--ref_point VALUE] [--out_chunks VALUE] [--n_workers VALUE] [--threads_per_worker VALUE]
