docs.title: mcf-pc
docs.text:
Minimum cost flow phase unwrapping of point cloud interferograms. Every interferogram is unwrapped alone on the Delaunay network of the points. The network stays in memory, about 50 bytes per point (100 with spatial_cost 'length'), and every interferogram unwrapped at the same time needs about 160 bytes per point more.

moraine mcf-pc --gix STR --ph STR --unw_ph STR --image_pairs FILE --range_pixel_spacing VALUE --azimuth_pixel_spacing VALUE [--earth_cost VALUE] [--spatial_cost STR] [--n_workers VALUE] [--out_chunks VALUE]
​参数​ ​类型​ ​默认值​ ​说明​ --gix str ​必需​ input grid index (azimuth, range) of the points, shape (n_points, 2), int; the points must be unique --ph str ​必需​ input wrapped phase history (complex), shape (n_points, nimages), chunked one image per chunk (points_block, 1) --unw_ph str ​必需​ output unwrapped phase of the interferograms in radians, shape (n_points, n_pairs), float32, chunks (out_chunks, 1); the first point keeps its wrapped phase --image_pairs np.ndarray ​必需​ image pairs (reference, secondary) of the interferograms to unwrap, shape (n_pairs, 2); the interferogram is reference * conj(secondary) --range_pixel_spacing float ​必需​ range pixel spacing in meters --azimuth_pixel_spacing float ​必需​ azimuth pixel spacing in meters --earth_cost int 1 cost of a phase jump across the convex hull of the points, relative to 1 inside; a larger value discourages discharging residues through the border --spatial_cost str 'constant' where phase jumps are placed first: 'constant' (anywhere alike) or 'length' (long connections between points) --n_workers int None number of interferograms unwrapped at the same time; by default as many as the available cores and half of the available memory allow --out_chunks int None point chunk size of unw_ph, same as ph by default

​全局​选项​：--json、--traceback、--log FILE、-q / --quiet（​约定​）。

​在​ pipeline ​文件​中​（examples/05_unwrap.toml，​步骤​ unwrap）：

[[step]]
name = "unwrap"
run = "mcf-pc"
gix = "unw/pc_gix.zarr"
ph = "pc/pc_ph.zarr"
unw_ph = "unw/pc_unw.zarr"
image_pairs = "unw/pairs_seq.txt"
range_pixel_spacing = "${range_pixel_spacing}"
azimuth_pixel_spacing = "${azimuth_pixel_spacing}"

​在​ Python ​中​：

import moraine.cli as mc
mc.mcf_pc(gix, ph, unw_ph, image_pairs, range_pixel_spacing, azimuth_pixel_spacing, earth_cost=1, spatial_cost='constant', n_workers=None, out_chunks=None)

​数组​函数​ mr.mcf_pc ​对​内存​中​的​ numpy / cupy ​数组​做​同样​的​事​。

docs.title: emcf-pc
docs.text:
Extended minimum cost flow (EMCF) phase unwrapping of point cloud interferograms. The interferograms of a network of image pairs are unwrapped together: the redundancy of the network (image pairs that close loops, e.g. (a, b), (b, c) and (a, c)) is used against unwrapping errors. The coordinates and the network of the points stay in memory, about 120 bytes per point, and every interferogram unwrapped at the same time needs about 200 bytes per point more. Intermediate results are written to unw_ph.tmp (kept if the command fails, removed at the end).

moraine emcf-pc --gix STR --ph STR --image_pairs FILE --unw_ph STR --range_pixel_spacing VALUE --azimuth_pixel_spacing VALUE [--dates PATH [PATH ...]] [--weight STR] [--earth_cost VALUE] [--temporal_cost STR] [--spatial_cost STR] [--n_workers VALUE] [--out_chunks VALUE]
​参数​ ​类型​ ​默认值​ ​说明​ --gix str ​必需​ input grid index (azimuth, range) of the points, shape (n_points, 2), int; the points must be unique --ph str ​必需​ input wrapped phase history (complex), shape (n_points, nimages), chunked one image per chunk (points_block, 1) --image_pairs np.ndarray ​必需​ the interferograms: (reference, secondary) image indices, shape (n_pairs, 2), e.g. a file made by image-pairs (--bandwidth 3: every image with the next three); the interferogram is reference * conj(secondary); without any loop in the network every interferogram is unwrapped alone --unw_ph str ​必需​ output unwrapped phase of the interferograms in radians, shape (n_points, n_pairs), float32, chunks (out_chunks, 1); at the first point the difference of the wrapped phases of the two images. Loops of image pairs may still not add up to zero at some points: see unwrap-correct-closure-pc --range_pixel_spacing float ​必需​ range pixel spacing in meters --azimuth_pixel_spacing float ​必需​ azimuth pixel spacing in meters --dates str or list None acquisition date of every image (YYYYMMDD), nimages values; needed by temporal_cost 'length' --weight str None input quality of the points from 0 (unreliable) to 1, e.g. the temporal coherence, shape (n_points,); needed by spatial_cost 'weight' --earth_cost int 1 cost of a phase jump across the border of the network of points, relative to 1 inside; a larger value discourages discharging residues through the border --temporal_cost str 'constant' which interferograms are corrected first where the interferograms of a loop of image pairs disagree: 'constant' (all alike) or 'length' (the longest in time) --spatial_cost str 'constant' where phase jumps are placed first in every interferogram: 'constant' (anywhere alike), 'length' (long connections between points), 'weight' (points of low weight) or 'length+weight' --n_workers int None number of interferograms unwrapped at the same time; by default as many as the available cores and half of the available memory allow --out_chunks int None point chunk size of unw_ph, same as ph by default

​全局​选项​：--json、--traceback、--log FILE、-q / --quiet（​约定​）。

​在​ pipeline ​文件​中​（​示例​ pipeline ​未​使用​此​命令​；​只列​必需​参数​）：

[[step]]
name = "emcf_pc"
run = "emcf-pc"
gix = "..."
ph = "..."
image_pairs = "..."
unw_ph = "..."
range_pixel_spacing = "..."
azimuth_pixel_spacing = "..."

​在​ Python ​中​：

import moraine.cli as mc
mc.emcf_pc(gix, ph, image_pairs, unw_ph, range_pixel_spacing, azimuth_pixel_spacing, dates=None, weight=None, earth_cost=1, temporal_cost='constant', spatial_cost='constant', n_workers=None, out_chunks=None)

​数组​函数​ mr.emcf_pc ​对​内存​中​的​ numpy / cupy ​数组​做​同样​的​事​。

docs.title: unwrap-correct-closure-pc
docs.text:
Correction of unwrapping errors of point cloud interferograms by phase closure, to the unwrapped phase of every image. The unwrapped phases of every loop of image pairs should add up to zero, e.g. unw(a, b) + unw(b, c) = unw(a, c). Where they do not, the interferograms are corrected by whole cycles, changing as few interferograms as possible, by the same amount for all points of a region: the points connected by edges of the point network no longer than max_edge_factor times the median edge length. Points of smaller regions than min_region_points are corrected one by one. The correction assumes that most interferograms of a region are right: where most are wrong, it makes them worse. Where a point still does not fit the loops after the correction of its region, the interferograms fitting most of its loops are kept. The result is the unwrapped phase of every image, whose differences close every loop. Errors that close every loop (e.g. the same whole cycles in every interferogram of one image) are neither corrected nor reported. The region of every point stays in memory (4 bytes per point; about 100 bytes per point while the regions are made). Intermediate results are written to ts.tmp (kept if the command fails, removed at the end).

moraine unwrap-correct-closure-pc --gix STR --ph STR --unw_ph STR --image_pairs FILE --ts STR --range_pixel_spacing VALUE --azimuth_pixel_spacing VALUE [--ref VALUE] [--misclosure_fraction STR] [--change_fraction STR] [--region STR] [--max_edge_factor VALUE] [--min_region_points VALUE] [--n_workers VALUE] [--out_chunks VALUE]
​参数​ ​类型​ ​默认值​ ​说明​ --gix str ​必需​ input grid index (azimuth, range) of the points, shape (n_points, 2), int; the points must be unique --ph str ​必需​ input wrapped phase history (complex), shape (n_points, nimages), chunked one image per chunk (points_block, 1) --unw_ph str ​必需​ input unwrapped phase of the interferograms in radians, shape (n_points, n_pairs), chunked one interferogram per chunk (points_block, 1), e.g. from mcf-pc or emcf-pc; rewrapped, it must be the phase of ph[:, reference] * conj(ph[:, secondary]) --image_pairs np.ndarray ​必需​ the interferograms: (reference, secondary) image indices of the columns of unw_ph, shape (n_pairs, 2); the pairs must connect all images; the network needs loops (e.g. every image paired with the next three) to correct anything, otherwise only the image phases are computed (a warning is given) --ts str ​必需​ output unwrapped phase of every image relative to image ref in radians, shape (n_points, nimages), float32, chunks (out_chunks, 1); ts[:, ref] is 0; rewrapped, ts[:, j] is the phase of ph[:, j] * conj(ph[:, ref]); the corrected interferogram (a, b) is ts[:, a] - ts[:, b] --range_pixel_spacing float ​必需​ range pixel spacing in meters --azimuth_pixel_spacing float ​必需​ azimuth pixel spacing in meters --ref int 0 index of the reference image, 0 .. nimages - 1: the image phases are relative to it --misclosure_fraction str None output fraction of the interferograms of every point that do not fit the loops before the correction, shape (n_points,), float32, 0..1; 0 where every loop closes --change_fraction str None output fraction of the interferograms of every point whose whole cycles in ts differ from unw_ph, shape (n_points,), float32, 0..1; 0 where unw_ph was kept; large values mark points whose input unwrapping was poor (e.g. to be masked) --region str None output region of every point, shape (n_points,), int32: 0 .. n_regions - 1, or -1 for the points of regions smaller than min_region_points, corrected one by one (e.g. to be masked) --max_edge_factor float 4.0 edges of the point network longer than this times the median edge length do not connect a region, e.g. edges across water or decorrelated areas; larger than 1 --min_region_points int 30 in regions of fewer points every point is corrected by its own loops alone, which is less reliable --n_workers int None number of interferograms corrected at the same time; by default as many as the available cores and half of the available memory allow --out_chunks int None point chunk size of the outputs, same as unw_ph by default

​全局​选项​：--json、--traceback、--log FILE、-q / --quiet（​约定​）。

​在​ pipeline ​文件​中​（​示例​ pipeline ​未​使用​此​命令​；​只列​必需​参数​）：

[[step]]
name = "unwrap_correct_closure_pc"
run = "unwrap-correct-closure-pc"
gix = "..."
ph = "..."
unw_ph = "..."
image_pairs = "..."
ts = "..."
range_pixel_spacing = "..."
azimuth_pixel_spacing = "..."

​在​ Python ​中​：

import moraine.cli as mc
mc.unwrap_correct_closure_pc(gix, ph, unw_ph, image_pairs, ts, range_pixel_spacing, azimuth_pixel_spacing, ref=0, misclosure_fraction=None, change_fraction=None, region=None, max_edge_factor=4.0, min_region_points=30, n_workers=None, out_chunks=None)

​数组​函数​ mr.unwrap_correct_closure_pc ​对​内存​中​的​ numpy / cupy ​数组​做​同样​的​事​。

docs.title: shp: Spatially Homogeneous Pixels Identification
docs.text:
moraine.cli.shp ​的​命令​（​源码​）；​同样​的​函数​在​ Python ​里​以​ mc.<name>(...) ​调用​（import moraine.cli as mc）。​下面​的​帮助​由​ docstring ​生成​，​与​ moraine COMMAND --help ​相同​（docstring ​为​英文​）。

​命令​ ​摘要​ shp-test SHP identification through hypothesis test, and the selection of the SHPs at the level alpha. select-shp Select SHP based on pvalue of SHP test.

docs.title: shp-test
docs.text:
SHP identification through hypothesis test, and the selection of the SHPs at the level alpha.

moraine shp-test --rslc STR --is_shp STR --shp_num STR --az_half_win VALUE --r_half_win VALUE [--alpha VALUE] [--pvalue STR] [--method STR] [--chunks INT INT] [--cuda | --no-cuda] [--processes VALUE] [--n_workers VALUE] [--threads_per_worker VALUE]
​参数​ ​类型​ ​默认值​ ​说明​ --rslc str ​必需​ input rslc stack, shape (nlines, width, nimages) --is_shp str ​必需​ output True for the SHPs of each pixel, i.e. the pixels of its window whose p value is at least alpha, shape (nlines, width, 2az_half_win+1, 2r_half_win+1), bool --shp_num str ​必需​ output number of SHPs of each pixel, shape (nlines, width), int32 --az_half_win int ​必需​ azimuth half window size --r_half_win int ​必需​ range half window size --alpha float 0.05 significance level of the test, in (0, 1): a pixel is an SHP of the centre pixel of its window when its p value is at least alpha; a larger alpha keeps fewer SHPs --pvalue str None output p value of the test between each pixel and the pixels in its window, same shape as is_shp, float32; needed only to select the SHPs again at another level with select-shp --method str None test method, only 'ks' (two-sample Kolmogorov-Smirnov) is implemented. Default: 'ks' --chunks tuple[int, int] None (azimuth, range) processing chunk size, same as rslc by default --cuda bool False if use cuda for processing, false by default --processes None use processes (True) or threads (False) for the workers, only for cpu processing. Default: False --n_workers None number of workers. Default: 1 for cpu, one per GPU for cuda --threads_per_worker None tasks a worker runs at the same time. Default: 1

​全局​选项​：--json、--traceback、--log FILE、-q / --quiet（​约定​）。

​在​ pipeline ​文件​中​（examples/03_ds.toml，​步骤​ shp_test）：

[[step]]
name = "shp_test"                 # two sample KS test in a 7 x 27 window (about 100 m x 60 m on the ground), SHPs = p value >= alpha
run = "shp-test"
rslc = "raw/rslc.zarr"
az_half_win = 3
r_half_win = 13
is_shp = "ds/ras_is_shp.zarr"
shp_num = "ds/ras_shp_num.zarr"
alpha = 0.05                      # significance level; add pvalue = "ds/ras_pvalue.zarr" to keep the p values

​在​ Python ​中​：

import moraine.cli as mc
mc.shp_test(rslc, is_shp, shp_num, az_half_win, r_half_win, alpha=0.05, pvalue=None, method=None, chunks=None, cuda=False, processes=None, n_workers=None, threads_per_worker=None)

docs.title: select-shp
docs.text:
Select SHP based on pvalue of SHP test.

moraine select-shp --pvalue STR --is_shp STR --shp_num STR [--alpha VALUE] [--chunks INT INT] [--processes | --no-processes] [--n_workers VALUE] [--threads_per_worker VALUE]
​参数​ ​类型​ ​默认值​ ​说明​ --pvalue str ​必需​ input pvalue of hypothesis test --is_shp str ​必需​ output bool array, True for SHPs, same shape as pvalue --shp_num str ​必需​ output number of SHPs of each pixel, shape (nlines, width), int32 --alpha float 0.05 significance level of the test, in (0, 1): a pixel is an SHP of the centre pixel of its window when its p value is at least alpha, i.e. the test does not reject that both have the same distribution; a larger alpha keeps fewer SHPs --chunks tuple[int, int] None (azimuth, range) processing chunk size, same as pvalue by default --processes False use processes for the workers instead of threads, the default is False --n_workers 1 number of workers, the default is 1 --threads_per_worker 1 tasks a worker runs at the same time

​全局​选项​：--json、--traceback、--log FILE、-q / --quiet（​约定​）。

​在​ pipeline ​文件​中​（​示例​ pipeline ​未​使用​此​命令​；​只列​必需​参数​）：

[[step]]
name = "select_shp"
run = "select-shp"
pvalue = "..."
is_shp = "..."
shp_num = "..."

​在​ Python ​中​：

import moraine.cli as mc
mc.select_shp(pvalue, is_shp, shp_num, alpha=0.05, chunks=None, processes=False, n_workers=1, threads_per_worker=1)

​数组​函数​ mr.select_shp ​对​内存​中​的​ numpy / cupy ​数组​做​同样​的​事​。

docs.title: tnet: Temporal network (image pairs) for the CLI
docs.text:
moraine.cli.tnet ​的​命令​（​源码​）；​同样​的​函数​在​ Python ​里​以​ mc.<name>(...) ​调用​（import moraine.cli as mc）。​下面​的​帮助​由​ docstring ​生成​，​与​ moraine COMMAND --help ​相同​（docstring ​为​英文​）。

docs.title: image-pairs
docs.text:
Write the image pairs of a temporal network to a text file, for the image_pairs arguments.

moraine image-pairs --out STR [--rslc STR] [--nimages VALUE] [--bandwidth VALUE]
​参数​ ​类型​ ​默认值​ ​说明​ --out str ​必需​ output text file with two columns, reference and secondary image index --rslc str None input rslc stack (..., nimages), used to get the number of images; alternative to nimages --nimages int None number of images; alternative to rslc --bandwidth int None connect every image with the next bandwidth images (1: sequential interferograms); all image pairs by default

docs.title: transform: transform coordinate between projection
docs.text:
moraine.cli.transform ​的​命令​（​源码​）；​同样​的​函数​在​ Python ​里​以​ mc.<name>(...) ​调用​（import moraine.cli as mc）。​下面​的​帮助​由​ docstring ​生成​，​与​ moraine COMMAND --help ​相同​（docstring ​为​英文​）。

​命令​ ​摘要​ transform Coordinate transformation

docs.title: transform
docs.text:
Coordinate transformation. By default, the input should be longitude (xx_in) and latitude (yy_in) (in degree) and outputs are x (east) and y (south) coordinate in web mercator projection (for plot with google earth map). The chunks, shape and dtype of output are same as xx_in.

moraine transform --xx_in VALUE --yy_in VALUE --xx_out VALUE --yy_out VALUE [--epsg_in VALUE] [--epsg_out VALUE]
​参数​ ​类型​ ​默认值​ ​说明​ --xx_in ​必需​ input x coordinate (longitude in degree for the default epsg_in) --yy_in ​必需​ input y coordinate (latitude in degree for the default epsg_in) --xx_out ​必需​ output x coordinate in epsg_out, same shape and chunks as xx_in --yy_out ​必需​ output y coordinate in epsg_out, same shape and chunks as xx_in --epsg_in int 4326 EPSG code of the input coordinates (4326: WGS84 longitude/latitude) --epsg_out int 3857 EPSG code of the output coordinates (3857: web mercator)

​全局​选项​：--json、--traceback、--log FILE、-q / --quiet（​约定​）。

​在​ pipeline ​文件​中​（examples/01_load.toml，​步骤​ web_mercator）：

[[step]]
name = "web_mercator"             # e/n coordinates, used to plot point clouds on a map
run = "transform"
xx_in = "raw/lon.zarr"
yy_in = "raw/lat.zarr"
xx_out = "raw/e.zarr"
yy_out = "raw/n.zarr"

​在​ Python ​中​：

import moraine.cli as mc
mc.transform(xx_in, yy_in, xx_out, yy_out, epsg_in=4326, epsg_out=3857)

docs.title: 检查​结果
docs.text: ​结果​很大​，​绝不​要​把​它​整个​加载​进来​看​。moraine ​提供​三种​不用​写​绘图​脚本​的​检查​方式​，​工作​流​指南​ ​写明​每​一步​该​期待​什么​。

docs.title: 金字塔
docs.text:
​金字塔​是​栅格​（ras-pyramid）​或​渲染​到​网格​上​的​点云​（pc-pyramid）​的​多​分辨率​副本​，​存放​在​结果​旁边​ （​约定​，​英文​）。​示例​ pipeline ​为​值得​检查​的​结果​建了​金字塔​，moraine run ​还​把​每​一步​生成​的​ ​金字塔​存成​ PNG，​放在​ WORK/.moraine/<​文件名​>/quicklook/。

moraine ras-pyramid --ras ps/ras_adi.zarr --out_dir ps/ras_adi_pyramid
moraine pc-pyramid --pc pc/pc_ph.zarr --out_dir pc/pc_ph_pyramid --x pc/pc_e.zarr --y pc/pc_n.zarr --ras_resolution 20

docs.title: moraine info：​形状​、​分块​和​统计​量
docs.text:
moraine info ps/ras_adi.zarr ps/ras_adi_pyramid

  ps/ras_adi.zarr: float32 (981, 4160) chunks (1000, 1000)
  ps/ras_adi_pyramid: float32 (981, 4160) raster pyramid, 10 levels
    stats_level=0, nan_fraction=0.40655, min=0.0335447, max=4.39345, mean=0.537522, std=0.0957743, p01=0.255305, p50=0.541975, p99=0.786118

​普通​数组​只读​元​数据​。​金字塔​的​统计​量​来自​某个​粗​层级​（nan_fraction、min、max、mean、std、p01、p50、 p99；​复数​数据​给​幅度​，​布尔​数据​给​ true_fraction），warnings ​指出​异常​：​全是​ nan、​有​无穷​值​或常​数值​。​加​ --json ​后​同样​的​数字​是​一个​ JSON ​对象​（​约定​）。

docs.title: moraine quicklook：​一张​图
docs.text:
moraine quicklook ps/ras_temp_coh_pyramid -o tcoh.png
moraine quicklook raw/rslc_pyramid --show intf_seq --index 5 -o intf_5.png
moraine quicklook raw/rslc_pyramid --show intf_all --index 0 91 --extent 1400,0,2600,600 -o zoom.png

--show ​选择​堆栈​要画​什么​：phase（​复数​数据​的​默认值​）、intf_0（​与​第一​景​的​干涉​图​）、intf_seq（​第​ I ​幅​序列​ ​干涉​图​）、intf_all（​任意​像​对​ ref sec）、coh、coh_abs。​相位​用​ (-π, π] ​上​的​循环​色标​，​其他​值用​ 1-99 % ​范围​内​的​ viridis。--extent ​画​场景​的​一部分​（​地图​上​是​ west,south,east,north ​度​，​雷达​网格​上​是​ range_min,azimuth_min,range_max,azimuth_max ​像​元​）：​范围​越小用​的​层级​越细​，​直到​单个​像​元​ / ​点​；​标题​给出​范围​和​层级​。 ​先看​整幅​场景​，​再​放大​看起来​不​对​的​地方​。

​看​什么​：​条纹​应当​连续​，​噪声​应当​出现​在​相干性​低​的​地方​，​选出​的​点​应当​覆盖​稳定​区域​（​城镇​、​岩石​），​解缠​相位​在​相邻​区域​ ​之间​不​应有​孤立​的​ 2π ​跳变​。

docs.title: moraine view：notebook ​里​的​交互​地图
docs.text:
moraine view ps/ras_adi_pyramid pc/pc_ph_pyramid -o view.ipynb --show intf_seq --dates raw/meta.toml

​生成​一个​ notebook，​每个​金字塔​一张​地图​：​缩放​平移​时​从​金字塔​层级​读取​细节​，​滑块​选择​影像​，​点击​一个​像​元​或​点​绘出​ ​它​的​时间​序列​，​双击​把​它​设为​参考​，​地图​上画​的​多边形​会​保存​下来​供​ polygon-mask ​使用​。notebook ​里​只有​路径​，​在​存放​ ​数据​的​机器​上​运行​，​所以​任何​ Jupyter ​或​ VS Code ​连接​都​能​用​，​不​需要​服务器​或​端口​转发​（​决策​ 0018）。

​同样​的​视图​在​ Python ​里​也​有​：mc.view(data) ​接受​金字塔​、​栅格​数组​或点​数据​（x=、y=）；show= ​选择​堆栈​显示​的​ ​内容​（'intf_seq' ​等​，​或​函数​ lambda v, ref, sec: ...），a * b ​叠加​视图​，a + b ​并排​显示​，repr(v) ​用​文字描述​ ​视图​，v.png('out.png', ...) ​保存​图片​。​见​ Python ​里​的​ moraine.cli。

docs.title: 预期​范围
docs.text: ​每份​工作​流​指南​都​有​一张​样例​数据​的​数值​和​合理​范围​的​表​，​例如​ PS ​候选​点​：​幅度​离差​指数​ p50 ​大约​在​ 0.3 ​到​ 1 ​之间​， ​时间​相干性​在​ 0 ​和​ 1 ​之间​，​候选​点​占​像​元​的​百分之几​到​ 30 % ​左右​。​每次​运行​后​把​ moraine info ​的​结果​和​表比​对​，​看过​ quicklook ​再​继续​；​超出范围​通常​意味着​参数​或​输入​有误​，​而​不是​区域​不同​。

docs.title: 概念
docs.text: moraine ​由​哪些​部分​组成​、​它们​怎样​配合​。​这里​的​十分钟​能省​下​翻​参考手册​的​几小时​。

docs.title: 一组​函数​，​而​不是​一条​固定​的​工作​流
docs.text:
​没有​哪条​工作​流​总能​给出​满意​的​ InSAR ​结果​：​失​相干​、​大气​和​强​形变​梯度​总会​在​某处​让​固定​的​处理​链​失效​。​所以​ moraine ​是​一组​函数​，​每个​函数​实现​一种​技术​（​幅度​离差​指数​、​同质​像​元​的​统计​检验​、EMI ​相位​连接​、​深度​学习​滤波​、​最小​费用​流解​缠​……）， ​再​加上​围绕​它们​的​数据​基础设施​。​处理​链​由​你​自己​组合​；​经过​验证​的​示例​ pipeline ​是​起点​，​不是​唯一​的​路​。

​数据​刻意​保持​简单​：​内存​中是​ numpy ​或​ cupy ​数组​，​磁盘​上​是​ zarr ​数组​。​没有​容器​对象​，​没有​工程​文件​；​每个​结果​都​是​ ​任何​工具​都​能​打开​的​数组​。

docs.title: 三层
docs.text:
层​ ​命名​空间​ ​数据​ ​一次​调用​处理​ API moraine.*（import moraine as mr） ​内存​中​的​ numpy（CPU，numba）​或​ cupy（GPU）​数组​；​输出​与​输入​同类​ ​一个​单元​：​整幅​场景​的​一景​影像​或​一个​像​对​，​或​一块​像​元​ / ​点​及其​完整​时间​序列​ CLI moraine.cli.*（import moraine.cli as mc） ​磁盘​上​的​ zarr ​数据​集​，​可​大于​内存​；​由​ moraine ​自己​的​ worker ​分块​处理​，CPU ​上用​线程​，​每块​ GPU ​一个​进程​ ​整个​数据​集​ ​命令​ moraine COMMAND ...、moraine run FILE ​同样​的​ zarr ​数据​集​ ​整个​数据​集​，​从​ shell ​或​ pipeline ​文件​运行​

CLI ​函数​不是​ API ​函数​的​简单​封装​：​它​把​数据​切成​ API ​函数​能​处理​的​单元​，​作为​执行器​的​任务​来​运行​（CPU ​上​是​线程​，​每块​ GPU ​一个​进程​；​决策​ 0033、0034）， ​再​写​回​ zarr。​每个​ moraine.cli ​函数​都​是​ moraine ​可执行程序​的​一条​命令​，​帮助​由​ docstring ​生成​（​决策​ 0005）， ​所以​三层​永远​一致​。help(mr.emi)、help(mc.emi) ​和​ moraine emi --help ​说​的​是​同​一件​事​。

import moraine as mr
import moraine.cli as mc

ph = mr.emi(coh)                                   # ​内存​中​的​一块​点​
mc.emi('ds/ds_can_coh.zarr', 'ds/ds_can_ph.zarr', cuda=True)   # ​整个​数据​集​，​在​ GPU ​上​

moraine emi --coh ds/ds_can_coh.zarr --ph ds/ds_can_ph.zarr --cuda

docs.title: 栅格​与​点云
docs.text:
​处理​链里​流动​的​数据​集有​两种​（​完整​约定​见​数据​约定​，​英文​）：

  • ​雷达​网格​上​的​栅格​：​形状​ (nlines, width[, n])，​方位​向​在​前​、​距离​向​在​后​、​堆栈​维在​最后​。rslc ​堆栈​是​ (nlines, width, nimages) ​的​ complex64；nan ​表示​缺失​数据​。
  • ​选出​像​元​（PS、DS）​的​点云​：​形状​ (n_points, ...) ​的​数组​。​点用​网格​索引​ gix (n_points, 2)（​方位​，​距离​） ​或​ hilbert ​索引​ hix (n_points,) ​定位​，​点云​按​ hilbert ​顺序​存放​，​数组​里​相邻​的​点​在​地面​上​也​相邻​。pc-union、 pc-intersect、pc-diff ​和​ pc-select-data ​是​排好序​的​索引​上​的​集合​运算​；ras2pc ​和​ pc2ras ​在​两种​数据​之间​搬运​。

​干涉​数据​是​复数​：​像​对​ (ref, sec) ​的​干涉​图是​ ref * conj(sec)，​相位​连接​后​的​相位​历史​和​滤波​后​的​干涉​图​幅度​为​ 1， ​点云​的​相干性​压缩​存放​（​相干​矩阵​的​上​三角​，(n_points, n_pairs)），​解缠​相位​是​ float32 ​弧度​ (n_points, n_pairs)。

docs.title: 分块
docs.text: zarr ​数组​按块​存放​，worker ​并行处理​各块​；​块​的​布局​决定​内存​和​速度​。moraine ​的​约定​（​决策​ 0019）​是​：​空间​上​分块​， ​每景​影像​（​或​每个​像​对​）​一个​块​，​例如​栅格​堆栈​ (lines_block, width_block, 1)、​点云​堆栈​ (points_block, 1)。 ​按​影像​处理​的​步骤​读​整块​，​按​空间​块​处理​的​步骤​读​每景​影像​的​一块​，​都​不​需要​重新​分块​。​命令​有​ chunks（​处理​）​和​ out_chunks（​存储​）​参数​；​块​太小​时间​都​花​在​调度​上​，​太大则​内存​不够​。​栅格​沿​方位​向​而​不是​距离​向​切分​。

docs.title: 处理​链
docs.text:
​示例​ pipeline ​实现​了​一条​常见​的​处理​链​；​每​一步​都​是​一条​命令​，​都​可以​替换​：

  1. ​载入​ GAMMA ​结果​到​ zarr：​去​平去​地形​的​ rslc ​堆栈​、​坐标​、​视​向量​、​元​数据​（01）。
  2. PS ​候选​点​：​幅度​离差​指数​，​以及​ Noise2Fringe ​滤波​后​干涉​图​的​时间​相干性​（02）。
  3. DS：​统计​同质​像​元​（KS ​检验​）、DS ​候选​点​、​相干​矩阵​、​带自​适应​正则​化​的​ EMI ​相位​连接​，​按​加权​时间​相干性​和​ ​相干​像​对​的​连通性​筛选​ DS（03）。
  4. ​合并​与​精化​：PS ​和​ DS ​合在一起​，​用​ Noise2Fringe Transformer ​滤波​，​按​时间​相干性​保留​（04）。
  5. ​解缠​：​点​的​ Delaunay ​网络​上​的​最小​费用​流​，​逐幅​干涉​图​（mcf-pc）​或​冗余​网络​整体​（emcf-pc）​解缠​， ​按​相位​闭合​校正​解缠​误差​（05）。

docs.title: Pipeline、​续​跑​与​ JSON
docs.text: ​一条​处理​链​就是​一个​ TOML ​文件​，​由​ moraine run FILE ​运行​（Pipeline ​文件​，​英文​）。 ​参数​相同​且​输入​没变​的​步骤​会​被​跳​过​，​所以​出错​或​改​了​参数​之后​再​运行​一次​文件​即可​。moraine run FILE --dry-run ​显示​ ​将要​运行​什么​，moraine status FILE ​显示​状态​。​加​ --json ​后​每条​命令​在​ stdout ​打印​一个​ JSON ​对象​，​日志​走​ stderr （JSON ​输出​）：​脚本​和​ AI agent ​读​的​就是​它​。

docs.title: GPU ​还是​ CPU
docs.text: API ​函数​接受​ numpy ​或​ cupy ​数组​，​按类型​分派​（moraine.api.utils_.get_array_module）；CLI ​函数​和​命令​用​ cuda ​参数​（​每块​ GPU ​一个​ worker ​进程​，​从​ cupy ​的​内存​池​分配​）。​只有​ CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES ​列出​了​ GPU ​才​会​用​它​。​影像​很多​ （​超过​约​ 100 ​景​）​时​，​相位​连接​在​多​核​ CPU ​上​可能​比​单块​ GPU ​更​快​；​指南​里​有​数字​。

docs.title: 安装
docs.text: moraine ​是​一个​ Python ​包​（>= 3.11）。​所有​功能​都​能​用​ numba ​在​ CPU ​上​运行​；GPU ​包是​可选​的​，​能​让​重​的​步骤​ （​相位​连接​、​深度​学习​滤波​、​相干性​估计​）​快​很多​倍​。

docs.title: 仅​ CPU
docs.text:
pip install moraine

​或者​用​ conda：

conda install -c conda-forge moraine

docs.title: GPU（CUDA）
docs.text:
GPU ​代码​需要​ cupy ​和​ numba-cuda，​它们​必须​与​机器​的​ CUDA ​驱动​匹配​。​先看​驱动​支持​的​最高​ CUDA ​版本​：

nvidia-smi

+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| NVIDIA-SMI 525.105.17   Driver Version: 525.105.17   CUDA Version: 12.0     |
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------+

​用​ conda ​安装​对应​版本​的​包​（​这里​以​ 11.8 ​为例​），​再装​ moraine：

conda install -c "nvidia/label/cuda-11.8.0" cuda-toolkit
conda install -c conda-forge cupy numba-cuda cuda-version=11.8
pip install moraine

moraine ​怎样​找到​ GPU

​只有​当​ CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES ​设为​非​空值​时​ moraine ​才​使用​ GPU；​否则​每条​命令​都​在​ CPU ​上​运行​（cuda = false）。 GPU ​命令​为​列出​的​每块​ GPU ​启动​一个​ worker ​进程​；​少列​几块​就​能​留出​空闲​的​ GPU。numba-cuda ​通过​激活​的​ conda ​环境​ （CONDA_PREFIX）​或​ CUDA_HOME ​找​ CUDA ​库​；​脚本​直接​调用​某个​环境​的​ python ​而​没有​激活​它​时​，moraine ​会​把​ CUDA_HOME ​设为​该​环境​。

docs.title: 深度​学习​滤波
docs.text:
n2f、n2fs3d ​和​ n2ft ​需要​ PyTorch ​和​训练​好​的​模型​：

pip install 'moraine[dl]'        # ​或​按​ PyTorch ​指南​为​你​的​ CUDA ​版本​安装​ torch
python -c "import moraine; moraine.download_dl_model()"

​模型​只​下载​一次​，​放在​包​目录​（moraine/dl_model/）​里​。​模型​的​许可​是​ CC BY-NC-SA 4.0；​代码​是​ GPL-3.0。

docs.title: GAMMA
docs.text: ​载入​ GAMMA ​结果​（load-gamma-*）​要​运行​ GAMMA ​程序​（phase_sim_orb、create_offset、geocode、base_calc）， ​它们​必须​在​ PATH ​上​。​其余​功能​都​不​需要​ GAMMA：mcf-pc ​和​ emcf-pc ​的​解缠​是​ moraine ​自己​的​实现​。

docs.title: 开发​模式
docs.text:
git clone git@github.com:kanglcn/moraine.git
cd moraine
pip install -e '.[dev,dl,docs]'
pytest -m "not slow"             # ​需要​样例​数据​、GPU、GAMMA ​或​模型​的​测试​会​被​跳​过​
mkdocs serve                     # ​本手册​，​在​ http://127.0.0.1:8000/

​改动​代码​的​方法​和​验证​步骤​见​开发​ moraine（​英文​）。

docs.title: 检查
docs.text:
moraine list                     # ​处理​命令​
moraine emi --help               # ​某条​命令​的​参数​
python -c "import moraine; print(moraine.__version__)"

docs.title: 教程
docs.text:
​仓库​里​ nbs/Tutorials/CLI/CampiFlegrei/ ​的​五个​ notebook：​与​工作​流​相同​的​步骤​，​写成​ moraine.cli ​的​ Python ​调用​，​每个​结果​都​有​交互​视图​（mc.view），​数据​是​ Campi Flegrei（Sentinel-1 ​降轨​ track 22， 2019-2021 ​共​ 92 ​景​，​那不勒斯​附近​正在​隆升​的​火山口​：​城市​，PS ​和​ DS ​都​多​；​数据​的​制作​过程​见​ data/CampiFlegrei/README.md）。 notebook ​的​内容​是​英文​的​。

notebook ​做​什么​ 01 ​载入​数据​ GAMMA ​结果​转​ zarr，​坐标​，​元​数据​ 02 PS ​处理​ ​幅度​离差​、Noise2Fringe ​时间​相干性​、PS ​候选​点​ 03 DS ​处理​ SHP、DS ​候选​点​、​相干​矩阵​、​相位​连接​、DS ​筛选​ 04 ​像​元​精化​ ​合并​ PS ​和​ DS，Noise2Fringe Transformer，​时间​相干性​ 05 ​相位​解缠​ EMCF ​解缠​与​相位​闭合​校正​

​只有​文字​和​代码​

notebook ​提交​时不带​输出​，​所以​这些​页面​只有​文字​和​代码​，​没有​图​。​在​ Jupyter ​或​ VS Code ​里​运行​ notebook ​可以​看到​ ​交互​地图​，​或者​看​工作​流​指南​和​ agent ​会话​里​真实​运行​的​图​。​每页​都​链接​到​ GitHub ​上​的​ notebook。

​按​顺序​运行​；​每个​ notebook ​读取​前面​各步​在​它​自己​文件夹​里​的​结果​。

docs.title: 工作​流
docs.text:
moraine ​的​处理​链是​五个​经过​验证​的​ pipeline ​文件​（​决策​ 0009、0033）：​每个​文件​改动​前​都​在​样例​数据​集上​完整​跑​一遍​， ​指南​里​的​数字​和​图​都​来自​那次​运行​。​样例​数据​集是​ Campi Flegrei：Sentinel-1 ​降轨​ track 22，2019-01-02 ​到​ 2021-12-29 ​共​ 92 ​景​，​全​分辨率​ 981 x 4160 ​像​元​，​那不勒斯​西边​正在​隆升​的​火山口​（​仓库​里​的​ data/CampiFlegrei/README.md ​说明​ GAMMA ​结果​是​怎样​做​出来​的​）。​文件​的​ [vars] ​默认值​就是​它​的​值​；​其他​数据​用​ --var ​给出​你​的​值​。​五个​文件​共用​一个​ ​工作​目录​、​互相​读取​输出​，​所以​要​按​顺序​运行​：

moraine run examples/01_load.toml --workdir WORK --var gamma=/path/to/gamma --var reference=YYYYMMDD --var geo=YYYYMMDD
moraine run examples/02_ps.toml --workdir WORK --var shape=NLINES,WIDTH
moraine run examples/03_ds.toml --workdir WORK --var shape=NLINES,WIDTH
moraine run examples/04_refine.toml --workdir WORK
moraine run examples/05_unwrap.toml --workdir WORK --var shape=NLINES,WIDTH --var range_pixel_spacing=... --var azimuth_pixel_spacing=...
pipeline ​指南​ ​做​什么​ ​输出​ examples/01_load.toml 01 ​载入​ GAMMA ​结果​ GAMMA ​结果​转​ zarr，​坐标​，web mercator WORK/raw/ examples/02_ps.toml 02 PS ​候选​点​ ​幅度​离差​ + Noise2Fringe ​时间​相干性​ WORK/ps/ examples/03_ds.toml 03 DS ​处理​ SHP、DS ​候选​点​、​相干性​、​相位​连接​、DS ​筛选​ WORK/ds/ examples/04_refine.toml 04 ​合并​与​精化​ PS + DS，Noise2Fringe Transformer，​时间​相干性​ WORK/pc/ examples/05_unwrap.toml 05 ​相位​解缠​ Delaunay ​网络​上​的​最小​费用​流​ WORK/unw/

​要​改​参数​，​把​文件​复制到​工作​目录​再​改​副本​，​或者​用​ --var name=value ​覆盖​ [vars] ​里​的​值​。​再次​运行​时​，​参数​和​输入​都​没变​ ​的​步骤​会​被​跳​过​，​改动​下游​的​步骤​重跑​；moraine run FILE --dry-run ​显示​计划​，moraine status FILE ​显示​状态​。​失败​的​ ​步骤​会​打印​错误​和​日志​；​修好​原因​后​再​运行​一次​文件​。​文件格式​见​ Pipeline ​文件​约定​（​英文​）； moraine run FILE --json ​在​ stdout ​打印​一个​ JSON ​对象​，​含​计划​、​各步​记录​和​输出​摘要​（JSON ​输出​）。

​五份​指南​目前​是​英文​的​。​每份​都​列出​步骤​、​要调​的​参数​、​样例​数据​集上​的​预期​结果​和​那次​运行​的​图​，​以及​数字​不​对​时​怎么办​。 ​指南​就是​ AI agent ​读​的​文件​；​那次​会话​记录​在​样例​数据​集上​运行​的​正是​这​五个​文件​。
